title: AI Video Creator for a YouTube Channel (Long-Term, Remote)
description:
We're looking for an AI Video Creator to join an established YouTube channel in the money education niche. The channel is introducing a new visual style using AI-generated imagery and video clips, and we need someone to own that production pipeline.



Scripts and voiceover are provided in both English and French — your job is to generate all visuals, add captions, and assemble the final videos.



Benchmark quality:

This is the standard we're working toward:





What you'll be working on:



Generating AI video clips for the opening section of each video (approximately the first 2 minutes)

Generating AI images for the remaining portion of each video (approximately 23 minutes)

Assembling all visuals to the provided voiceover with smooth transitions, pacing, and text overlays where needed

Adding burned-in captions/subtitles synced to the voiceover for both the English and French versions

Working with a fixed main character and supporting characters — you must maintain consistent character appearance, clothing, and style across every video and every scene

Producing a French version of each video using the provided French script and voiceover (same visuals, French captions)

Delivering two completed videos (one English, one French) approximately every 4 days



Requirements:



Portfolio or samples showing AI-generated video content at or near the benchmark quality above

Proven ability to maintain character consistency across multiple AI-generated scenes and videos (this is critical — please show examples)

Experience with AI image and video generation tools 

Experience adding clean, well-timed captions/subtitles to long-form video

Video editing skills to assemble the final product (Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar)

Reliable delivery on a recurring schedule

Willingness to complete a small paid test task after initial discussion



Work details:



Remote, long-term collaboration

Monthly payment

Established channel with an existing audience

All scripts, voiceover, and character designs are provided for both languages

Clear communication and simple workflows



How to apply:



Please send:



2–3 samples of AI-generated video content you've created (ideally long-form or explainer style)

Examples showing consistent character design across multiple scenes or videos

A short note on which AI tools you use and your production process

How soon you'd be available to start



To confirm you've read this post carefully, please start your message with the word "COIN".

This is not "add captions and export." I'm looking for someone who edits for retention — who knows where to cut a breath, when to punch in, when to drop a 
, and when to leave a beat of silence because it hits harder.



What you'll do



Edit 10-30 short-form videos per week (30–90 seconds, vertical 9:16)

4 long form (and cut clips for short form)

Cut raw talking-head footage into tight, story-driven edits —no dead air, no filler

Add kinetic/animated captions (styled consistently, not stock auto-captions)

Source and layer B-roll, screenshots, 
s, text overlays, and reaction cutaways that support the point being made

Sound design: music beds, SFX, whooshes, volume ducking, clean audio levels

Design or adapt cover frames/hook text

Occasionally repurpose podcast footage into clips

Deliver via Google Drive or 
 with a simple naming convention



Style reference















Study these before applying. This is the exact energy, pacing, and caption style I want. If you can't match it, this isn't the right role for you  and that's fine.



You're a good fit if you



Have 2+ years editing short-form for creators or personal brands (not just corporate/wedding work)

Are fluent in Premiere Pro or CapCut (After Effects is a plus, not required)

Understand English well enough to catch the joke, the punchline, and the emotional beat — you're editing for meaning, not just waveform

Can turn around an edit in 24–48 hours

Communicate proactively on Slack and don't disappear

Care about the view-through rate, not just the export



Not a fit if you need a detailed shot-by-shot brief for every video, only work from templates, or outsource the work to someone else.





Start: ASAP, 1-month paid trial, then long-term

Paid via [Wise / PayPal / your method], [weekly / bi-weekly]



How to apply



Applications that skip these steps get deleted. No exceptions.



Subject line: Yap Editor — [your favorite movie]

Send a portfolio link with 3 short-form talking-head edits you personally cut. Not agency reels, not compilations. Yours.

In 3 sentences: watch the style reference above and tell me one specific editing choice they make that most editors don't.

Tell me what software you use and your average turnaround time on a 60-second edit.

Optional but it will move you to the top of the pile: I'll send raw footage on request — edit 30 seconds of it your way.

description:
About the role



We're a done-for-you GTM agency. Our clients are freight forwarders and customs brokers — small operators who are great at moving cargo and terrible at generating pipeline. We build and run their entire outbound motion across
 and LinkedIn: list, infrastructure, copy, sending, reply handling.



You'd own campaign execution end to end. Not a "VA who uploads CSVs" role — you're the person who d
 how the list gets built, why deliverability dropped, and what to change when a sequence stalls at 0.4% reply rate.



What you'll do



Data & targeting



Build and enrich ICP lists in Clay — waterfall enrichment, HTTP API columns, dedupe, validation

Source and verify contacts (Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay providers, manual research where data is thin)



Cold



Stand up sending infrastructure: buy domains, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, connect inboxes, manage warmup

Deploy and monitor sequences in
Bison — pacing, rotation, spintax, A/B variants

Watch deliverability daily and diagnose issues before the client notices



LinkedIn outreach



Run client LinkedIn accounts through HeyReach (or similar) — connection requests, follow-up DM sequences, profile view and engagement steps

Build targeted Sales Navigator searches and keep lists synced with the
 side

Manage account health: warmup, daily limits, activity pacing, avoiding restrictions

Optimize client profiles so the outreach lands on a page that converts (headline, banner, About, featured)

Sequence
 and LinkedIn together so a prospect gets a coordinated multichannel touch pattern, not two disconnected campaigns



Across both



Triage replies, categorize interest, route qualified conversations to the client or to me

Maintain a weekly reporting snapshot per client: sent, delivered, connect rate, reply rate, positive replies, meetings

Write and iterate outreach copy for both channels (you'll get frameworks — you won't be starting blank)



You're a good fit if you



Have actually run outbound at volume — not read about it. You know what a 40% bounce rate means and what you'd do about it

Have hands-on Clay experience (close to non-negotiable) and can talk through a table you've built

Have run LinkedIn outreach on someone else's account and never gotten it restricted — and can explain why

Understand deliverability mechanics: domain age, warmup curves, spam triggers, inbox placement vs. open rate

Write clean, plain English. Our clients' prospects are freight operators, not SaaS founders — the copy has to sound like a person, not a template. LinkedIn DMs especially: short, human, no pitch-slapping

Are detail-obsessed. One misconfigured DNS record burns a domain. One aggressive connection cadence burns an account

Work independently and flag problems early instead of hiding them



Not a fit if you have only ever run one channel, need step-by-step instructions daily, or have "growth hacker" in your title but can't explain waterfall enrichment.



Logistics or freight background is a bonus, not a requirement. You'll learn the industry — I'll teach it.





Tools provided: Clay, Apollo,
Bison, HeyReach, Sales Navigator, Slack

Paid monthly via [Wise / Payoneer]



How to apply



Generic applications get deleted immediately. I read every one that follows these steps.



Subject line: GTM — [how many inboxes you'd run to send 6,000
s/month safely]

Answer in a short paragraph each:

A campaign has a 62% open rate and a 0.3% reply rate. What are the first three things you check?

Walk me through how you'd build a list of freight forwarders in the US with 5–50 employees and find the owner's
. Name the actual tools and steps.

How do you run LinkedIn outreach on a client's account for 6 months without it getting restricted? Give me your actual daily limits and warmup approach.

Paste in one cold
 and one LinkedIn connection-request-plus-follow-up you wrote that got replies. Include the rates if you have them.

List every outbound tool you've used and your comfort level with each (1–5).

Tell me the largest volume you've personally managed — inboxes, LinkedIn accounts, sends/month, clients.



Do not send a video intro. Do not send a resume as your only attachment.

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
About Viral Vault Studios



Viral Vault Studios is a digital content company that produces entertaining, informative, and high-retention faceless YouTube videos. Our content covers topics such as celebrity controversies, celebrity health, anime recaps, and other trending subjects.



We are looking for a creative, skilled, and detail-oriented YouTube Video Editor who can work quickly, collaborate effectively, and consistently deliver professional-quality videos.



Role Overview



The YouTube Video Editor will transform scripts and voice-overs into engaging long-form videos designed to maintain viewer attention.



This role requires more than assembling clips. You must understand storytelling, pacing, audience retention, visual sourcing, sound design, and YouTube Fair Use. You will also work collaboratively with other editors on shared projects, so communication, organization, and consistency are essential.



Key Responsibilities:

• Edit long-form YouTube videos using scripts and voice-overs.

• Create strong pacing, engaging openings, and clear visual storytelling.

• Match B-roll, interviews, news clips, screenshots, photos, social media posts, and graphics to the narration (if applicable).

• Use visual changes, pattern interrupts, transitions, music, sound effects, motion graphics, and other effects where appropriate.

• Identify slow or repetitive sections and improve them through editing.

• Ensure visuals are relevant, varied, and supportive of the story.

• Properly sync and balance narration, music, sound effects, and visuals.

• Use third-party content in a transformative and copyright-conscious manner.

• Track and organize the sources used in each video.

• Follow company editing SOPs, style guidelines, deadlines, and feedback.

• Collaborate with other editors working on the same project.

• Review and quality-check all work before submission.



Qualifications

• Previous experience editing YouTube or other social media content.

• Strong understanding of YouTube storytelling, pacing, and audience retention.

• Experience sourcing B-roll, stock footage, interviews, news clips, images, screenshots, and social media content.

• Working knowledge of YouTube Fair Use and copyright-conscious editing.

• Proficiency in at least one professional editing program, including: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Desktop

• Ability to follow detailed instructions and adapt based on feedback.

• Strong communication, organization, and attention to detail.

• Ability to work efficiently and consistently meet deadlines.

• Available to work 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM Philippine Time (PHT).



To be considered for this role, you MUST complete the following:



- Submit your updated resume

- Provide a portfolio or sample work

- For those selected, a test task is required to demonstrate ability (instructions will be provided)

title: Social Media Management Lead
description:
Social Media Lead, TikTok & Instagram | UK Fragrance



You will be filming yourself this week, on your phone. If that sentence puts you off, stop reading.



Do not apply if you are: a virtual assistant, an agency pitching a retainer, a project manager, a "digital marketing generalist", someone who schedules and reports on content other people make, or someone who has never been on camera. This role is built for one person who shoots, cuts, posts, and answers for the numbers.



The role:

1. You own our organic social presence end to end. Strategy, production, publishing, community, creators, commerce. You d
 what we make. You make most of it yourself. You read the data and you double down on what works.



2. You report to the founder. Real creative autonomy from day one. No committee, no approval queue, no brand deck to defend.



What you'll actually do:



-Own the content engine. 2 to 3 TikToks a day. Daily Instagram Reels. 3 to 5 Stories a day. 3 to 4 feed posts a week. Roughly 50 assets a week, most of them shot and cut by you. If that number frightens you, this is not your role.

-Execute the pillars. Behind the scenes lab and formulation content. On camera performance and wear tests, your face and our fragrances. Dupe culture formats: side by side comparisons, blind tests, seasonal edits. Community content built from what people actually ask us.

-Out-execute the competition. Track every major UK dupe brand daily. Find the gap they are ignoring. Beat them on performance led content, not louder branding.

-Run TikTok Shop and affiliates. Keep listings and bundles fresh. Grow the affiliate creator base. Run flash offers around key UK dates. You are accountable for click through to shop and attributed sales. Vanity reach counts for nothing here.

-Lead creator seeding. Identify and manage UK micro fragrance creators, 5k to 50k. Run gifting campaigns, write the briefs, keep every post ASA compliant, and convert the strongest relationships into ongoing partnerships.

-Run the community. Comments, DMs, comment reply videos, broadcast channel drops. Every question is a content idea.

-Report and iterate weekly. Views, follows, click through to shop, attributed sales. Kill what fails without ego. Scale what wins. 

-Hand the winning organic creative to paid for Spark Ads and Meta.



What you must have:



- 2+ years running brand social accounts with results you can prove. Accounts you grew. Videos that hit. Numbers you moved. We will ask for them in your first reply and again in the interview.

- You shoot and edit. CapCut or equivalent, fluently. You understand hooks, pacing, and why the first 1.5 seconds d
 everything.

- You go on camera. Non-negotiable. Wear tests and performance content need a face, and it is yours.

- Creative strategy. You can build a pillar system from scratch, write a hook that stops a scroll, and explain in one sentence why a video worked or flopped.

- TikTok Shop and the affiliate ecosystem. Hands on, or demonstrably fast to master it.

- Creator management. Outreach, briefs, gifting logistics, UK ad disclosure rules.

- Self-direction. Small team, fast pace, nobody checking your calendar.



Strong advantage: fragrance, beauty, or skincare experience.



To apply, send:

1. Your CV.

2. Your portfolio. Live links to the accounts you have run and the videos you have made. No Canva edit links, no locked folders, nothing we have to request access to.

3. Proof. TikTok Shop dashboards, creator campaign results, analytics screenshots, content calendars you built.



We move fast. Strong candidates hear back within 48 hours.

title: Fast-Paced STR Designer (Architecture Background Required, 5-Day Turnaround)
description:
We are a premium short-term rental (STR) design firm specializing in ROI-driven transformations with a 5-business-day turnaround model. We operate on a structured, template-based system built for speed, precision, and scalability. We're hiring 3–4 production-focused designers who thrive in deadline-driven environments.



This is not a boutique, slow creative role. It's a high-performance production environment — and a great fit if you want fast-paced, high-paying, consistent revenue without spending time on client acquisition.



## What Makes This Different

Our designers work across a variety of project types and aesthetics — not the same style on repeat. You'll get to see your designs come to life: our clients typically complete installs 6–12 weeks after design delivery, so your work becomes real spaces, not just renderings that sit in a folder. Our current team consistently tells us they value the clarity of our communication and expectations — you'll always know what's expected, when, and why.



## Responsibilities

- Execute full STR design projects (interior & exterior) within 5 business days

- Follow structured templates and sourcing systems

- Deliver high-quality, investor-focused, detail-oriented designs with strong consistency across projects

- Manage up to 2–3 concurrent projects

- Stay within included revision rounds per project (1 internal and 1 client)



## Compensation

Per-project compensation based on property size and scope. Typical project range: $350–$1,400 USD, averaging around $960 per project. Paid 50% on design package delivery with internal revisions complete, 50% on final client delivery with client revisions included. Quarterly performance bonus eligibility tied to company margin and timeline metrics.



## Requirements

- **Architecture background or experience required** (degree, coursework, or professional experience)

- Interior design experience preferred; strong interest in interior design is a plus if architecture background is solid

- Strong sourcing and budget control skills

- Ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality

- Excellent, clear communication

- Comfortable working within structured systems



We provide a structured onboarding program to get you fully ramped on our tools and workflow before your first project.



All shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test project (2 day turnaround required).



**Tools you'll use:** Canva, 
, Google Workspace/Sheets, AI rendering tools



## To Apply

If you thrive in fast-paced, high-accountability environments and want consistent project volume with variety and real design impact, apply with:



- Portfolio (architecture background clearly indicated)

- Monthly availability

- Confirmation of ability to meet 5-day deadlines

title: Amazon Account / Brand Operations Manager (Private Label)
description:
Are you a strategic, data-driven Amazon operator with a passion for optimization and brand growth?

We are a fast-growing Amazon private label brand seeking a full-time Amazon Account / Brand Operations Manager to oversee our listing performance, conversion optimization, and brand presence on Amazon.



You’ll play a key leadership role in improving conversion rates, maintaining a strong brand identity, and driving account health through data-backed decisions. This is a long-term opportunity with growth potential in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Ownership

Own and optimize Amazon listings for maximum visibility and conversions

Manage brand positioning, messaging, and consistency across listings, A+ content, and storefront

Implement CRO strategies and coordinate ongoing A/B tests

Coordinate freelancers and vendors (designers, photographers, copywriters, content creators)

Monitor and improve brand health metrics: rankings, reviews, CTR, CR, Buy Box, etc.

Ensure Amazon account hygiene: compliance, suppressed listings, variations, flat files (as needed), category attributes, and policy adherence



Daily & Weekly Tasks

Perform ongoing listing audits and implement improvements (titles, bullets, images, backend, A+, attributes)

Analyze competitors for positioning and conversion opportunities (without product scouting)

Track performance: sessions, conversion rate, CTR, sales rank, review velocity, return rate

Collaborate with PPC, supply chain, and creative teams to align:

Listing updates with ad strategy

Inventory levels with promo and demand forecasts

Creative needs with conversion goals

Manage reporting and ensure action items are executed consistently



Long-Term Projects & Goals

Build a consistent, strategic brand identity across all customer touchpoints on Amazon

Create a repeatable system for ongoing listing improvement and CRO

Improve customer loyalty and retention through stronger messaging, brand voice, and content

Develop SOPs for listing updates, creative briefs, review management, and performance reporting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI 1: Listing Quality & Organic Performance

Objective: Improve listing visibility and discoverability through optimization



Metrics:

Keyword indexing coverage + organic rank improvements

CTR improvements (Search + ads-supported)

Reduction in suppressed/invalid attributes and listing issues

Actions:

Run keyword research and update listings using Helium 10 + market analysis

Maintain listing audit checklist and optimization tracker

Monitor indexing, rank trends, and category attribute completeness



KPI 2: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Objective: Improve conversion rate through data-backed iteration

Metric: Conversion Rate (%) from Amazon Business Reports

Actions:

Optimize copy, images, A+ content, and brand story

Run split tests where possible (ManageByStats, Splitly, Experiments, or equivalent)

Monitor behavior signals (CTR, CVR, returns, reviews) and iterate



KPI 3: Brand Health & Customer Trust

Objective: Improve brand reputation and customer experience

Metrics:

Review rating + review velocity

Return rate trends and top return reasons

Q&A hygiene and listing clarity improvements

Actions:

Review monitoring + recurring issue reporting

Coordinate content updates to address objections/returns

Strengthen product education via visuals + A+ modules

Qualifications & Skills



Required

3+ years managing private label brands on Amazon (account management / listing optimization

Deep understanding of Amazon SEO and algorithm fundamentals

Strong experience with Helium 10, keyword research, and listing optimization

Proven ability to brief and coordinate creatives (designers, copywriters, photographers)

Familiarity with A+ content, storefront management, and conversion tracking

Strong operational discipline: can manage tasks, trackers, and deadlines without hand-holding



Preferred

Background in marketing, branding, or e-commerce growth strategy

Experience with CRO/testing platforms (e.g., ManageByStats, Splitly, Amazon Experiments)

Experience using Asana, Notion, or Trello for project management

Understanding of PPC’s relationship to CTR/CVR and organic rank (coordination-level, not necessarily hands-on media buying)



Soft Skills

Ownership mentality and high attention to detail

Strong marketing instincts and customer-centric thinking

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Organized, proactive, and reliable

Analytical mindset — able to turn data into decisions



What We Offer

Competitive rates

Fully remote

Bi-weekly payments and performance reviews

Long-term role with growth potential

Paid leave and additional benefits after 6 months (SSS, Pag-ibig, health insurance)

Supportive team culture with room for innovation and contribution

Training resources and personal development opportunities



How to Apply

Experience optimizing Amazon listings and improving conversion rates

Tools you’ve used and how you used them

A specific listing improvement you made and the result (CTR/CVR/rank/reviews)

Why Join Us?

This is more than just account management. It’s an opportunity to take ownership of Amazon performance, strengthen a real brand, and build systems that scale. If you’re driven by impact, autonomy, and measurable outcomes, we’d love to meet you.

title: Supply Chain & Project Manager
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 
/share/base/form/shrlg5pFuw8LjdqeGFOVZLD9i0d

(please do not submit application again if you have already done so)



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in USA and Singapore. Our supply chain span across 4 countries, 10+ suppliers and 3 warehouses. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino tea
mbers and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for a hands-on Supply Chain & Project Manager to support the Head of Supply Chain in executing Crafti's day-to-day operations - supplier coordination, production tracking and inventory management.



This role requires someone who is highly responsive, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-moving environment. Supply chain runs around the clock. Our suppliers operate across time zones, and updates can come at any hour. This is not a typical Monday to Friday, clock-in clock-out job.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Enjoy speaking with suppliers to ensure that they are able to deliver items on time

- Can process high volumes of information from multiple channels simultaneously and translate them into clear next actions, without needing someone to connect the dots

- Like to push projects forward and move things along rather than wait to be told what's next

- Enjoy keeping detailed records and staying organised



Do not apply if:



- Your supply chain experience is limited to admin support without direct supplier contact

- You are uncomfortable learning and using new software tools and AI independently

- You are not comfortable working outside standard hours when suppliers or shipments require it

- Your written English is not business-professional level



What You'll Do



- Supplier Communication & Coordination — monitor all communication channels daily and respond to supplier and team updates with urgency. Chase production status updates from 10+ suppliers at the same time



- Inventory Allocation — manage production splits across sales channels



- Production Tracking — update production records in our tracking database with same-day accuracy. Coordinate manufacturing schedules, flag any production delays or risks to the team proactively.



- Purchase Order & Manufacturing Order Management — create and track POs and MOs in MRPeasy.



- QC Process Management — prepare QC quote requests with QC checklists attached, coordinate QC inspections and review defect documentation



- Shipping Coordination — prepare transfer requests and coordinate with the logistics team to ensure products move from production to warehouses in Singapore and the US on schedule.



- Inventory Reporting — prepare monthly inventory reports, action low-stock items, and complete month-end reconciliation



What We Are Looking For:



Skills:



- 2+ years in supply chain, operations, or logistics at a product company

- Experience managing active supplier relationships

- Responsive and comfortable across multiple communication platforms simultaneously (WhatsApp,
, Wechat)

- Detail-oriented

- Comfortable with Tech tools and AI



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- High urgency and ownership - today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done no matter what

- Proactive Communicator - if I foresee something may be wrong, I will highlight as soon as possible

- Adaptable - I embrace new tools, new processes and AI; and I want to keep improving

- Has Opinions - I want to suggest a better way



Details



This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 70,000 – 130,000 per month (based on experience)



Commitment: Full-time, Philippine business hours (Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm PHT) with flexibility for supplier updates outside standard hours)

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING MANAGER - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

Remote Project Manager (Long-Term Position)

Calling All Graphics, Inc.



Location: Remote (Philippines Preferred)

Hours: 20–25 hours per week (Monday–Friday, U.S. Eastern Time mornings)

Compensation: Starting at $10–15 USD/hour, based on experience, with opportunities for increases based on performance.



Join a Growing U.S. Company



Calling All Graphics, Inc. is an established commercial printing, graphic design, signage, marketing, and promotional products company serving businesses throughout the New York City metropolitan area.



We are looking for an organized, dependable, and proactive Project Manager who wants to become a long-term member of our team. This is not a short-term freelance project—we're looking for someone who wants to grow with our company.



If you enjoy organizing projects, communicating with customers, solving problems, and making sure everything stays on schedule, we'd love to hear from you.



What You'll Do

-Coordinate multiple customer projects from start to finish.

-Communicate with customers, vendors, and our internal team.

-Track project schedules and ensure deadlines are met.

-Organize estimates, proofs, approvals, purchase orders, and job information.

-Follow up with vendors and suppliers to keep projects moving.

-Help coordinate printing, signage, promotional products, installations, and deliveries.

-Maintain accurate project records and customer information.

-Assist with customer service and quickly resolve issues when they arise.

We're Looking for Someone Who

-Is professional when communicating with customers.

-Works well independently.

-Is reliable and dependable.

-Learns quickly and enjoys solving problems.

-Has a stable internet connection and a quiet workspace.



Experience We Value

-Project management or operations experience.

-Customer service experience.

-Experience coordinating vendors or production.

-Commercial printing, graphic design, signage, marketing, or promotional products experience is a major plus.

-Adobe Illustrator and Adobe InDesign familiarity is helpful.

-Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

-QuickBooks experience is helpful but not required.



What We Offer

-Long-term, stable position with a growing U.S. company.

-Flexible remote work.

-Respectful, supportive work environment.

-Opportunity to increase hours as the company grows.

-Performance-based raises.

-Opportunity to grow into a full-time leadership position.



How to Apply



Please submit:



-Your resume.

-A brief introduction about yourself.

-Your desired hourly rate (USD).

-Your available working hours (U.S. Eastern Time). Preferably 8am - 1pm daily.

-A summary of your project management experience.

A 2-minute video introduction explaining why you believe you would be a great fit for this position.



Please also answer this question:



Tell us about a time when you managed multiple projects, customers, or vendors at the same time. How did you stay organized and make sure everything was completed successfully?



Applications without the requested information may not be considered.



Hiring Process

-A 20–30 minute Zoom interview.

-A paid 2–3 hour skills assessment.

-A 90-day probationary period.



If you're looking for a long-term opportunity where your work is appreciated and you can grow with an established U.S. company, we'd love to meet you.

title: Real Estate Closing Coordinator (U.S. Residential)
description:
About AIK Property Group



AIK Property Group is a residential real estate development company based in New York. We acquire, renovate, and sell homes while working closely with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, nonprofit organizations, and housing grant agencies.



We're looking for an experienced Real Estate Closing Coordinator who can take ownership of the transaction process and ensure every deal moves efficiently from contract execution to a successful closing.



This is not an entry-level position. We're seeking someone who already understands U.S. residential real estate transactions and can demonstrate that experience.



---



Your Mission



Your job is simple:



Keep every transaction moving toward closing.



You'll be responsible for coordinating multiple active transactions, anticipating issues before they become delays, following up relentlessly, and ensuring every party involved remains accountable.



You should always know:



* Which transactions are on track.

* Which transactions are at risk.

* What documents or approvals are outstanding.

* Who is responsible for the next action.

* What needs to happen today to move every file forward.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership—not someone who waits for instructions.



---



Key Responsibilities



* Coordinate residential real estate transactions from executed contract through closing.

* Manage multiple active transactions while maintaining accuracy and organization.

* Maintain transaction timelines and monitor all critical deadlines.

* Coordinate with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, contractors, grant administrators, and internal team members.

* Collect, organize, review, and track all required transaction documentation.

* Proactively identify and resolve issues that could delay closing.

* Maintain complete and organized transaction records.

* Provide accurate and timely updates on every active transaction.

* Ensure every transaction continues progressing until funding and closing are complete.



---



# What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of:



* U.S. residential real estate transactions

* Contract-to-close coordination

* Title and attorney coordination

* Lender communication and requirements

* Closing timelines and deadlines

* Document collection and compliance

* Managing multiple transactions simultaneously



You should also be comfortable learning and working within AIK Property Group's systems, including the **Greater Capital Association of REALTORS® (GCAR)** platform and other transaction management tools used by our team.



---



# Minimum Qualifications



* Minimum **3 years of experience** coordinating U.S. residential real estate transactions.

* Proven ability to successfully manage multiple active transactions simultaneously.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities.

* Highly dependable, responsive, and detail-oriented.

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.



---



# Application Requirements



We value demonstrated experience over résumé claims.



To be considered, your application must include all of the following:



* Updated résumé.

* Brief cover letter summarizing your real estate closing experience.

* Supporting evidence that demonstrates your transaction coordination experience.



Examples of acceptable supporting evidence include:



* Redacted closing checklists you managed.

* Sample transaction timelines.

* Screenshots of transaction pipelines or dashboards (with confidential information removed).

* Process documentation you created or maintained.

* Other work samples that clearly demonstrate your role in coordinating residential real estate closings.



Please remove or redact all confidential client information before submitting any documentation.



Applications submitted without supporting evidence will not be reviewed.



---



# Interview Process



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in a Transaction Case Review



During this session, you will be asked to share your screen and walk us through a completed transaction that you coordinated (using a redacted file or recreated workflow if necessary).



You should be prepared to explain:



* How the transaction progressed from contract to closing.

* The major milestones and deadlines.

* Challenges encountered during the process.

* How those challenges were resolved.

* How you kept all parties accountable.

* How you organize and prioritize multiple active transactions.



This is not intended to test memorization. We want to understand how you think, communicate, solve problems, and manage real-world transactions.



---



# What Success Looks Like



A successful Closing Coordinator:



* Keeps transactions moving without constant supervision.

* Anticipates issues before they become closing delays.

* Maintains proactive communication with every stakeholder.

* Keeps organized and accurate transaction files.

* Meets deadlines consistently.

* Takes ownership of every transaction from contract to closing.



When someone asks about the status of a file, you already know the answer.



---



# Who Will Thrive in This Role



You'll be a great fit if you are:



* Proactive.

* Organized.

* Reliable.

* Detail-oriented.

* Accountable.

* Calm under pressure.

* Comfortable making decisions and taking ownership.

* Committed to delivering successful closings—not simply completing assigned tasks.



---



# How to Apply



Please
 your application to:







**Required
 Subject Format**



**Closing Coordinator – F. LAST NAME**



**Example:** `Closing Coordinator – J. DELA CRUZ`



Applications that do not follow the required subject format or do not include the requested supporting documentation may not be considered.



---



Our Hiring Philosophy



At AIK Property Group, we hire based on capability, ownership, reliability, and demonstrated experience—not résumé claims alone.



If you're someone who takes pride in keeping transactions organized, solving problems before they become obstacles, and ensuring every closing reaches the finish line, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Role: Independent Sales Representative  

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (Monthly Retainer + Commission) 

Work Arrangement: Remote 

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer (COO) 

About Ro&® 

Ro&® is an Australian technology company specializing in AI-native Physical Risk Intelligence™ 

solutions. Our platform transforms video, sensor, and operational data into real-time 

intelligence that enables organizations to improve safety, security, compliance, and operational 

decision-making. 

As we continue to expand globally, we are seeking experienced independent sales professionals 

who are passionate about opening new commercial opportunities and introducing innovative 

technology solutions to organizations across multiple industries. 

About the Role 

This is an Independent Contractor role operating under a monthly retainer plus commission 

structure. The successful contractor will be responsible for generating new business 

opportunities, identifying and engaging prospective clients and Channel Partners, conducting 

introductory commercial discussions, arranging product demonstrations, and supporting 

opportunities through the sales process. 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Sales & Prospecting 

• Research and identify prospective organizations aligned with the Company's target 

market. 

• Identify executive-level decision-makers and key business contacts. 

• Generate qualified business opportunities through cold calling,
 outreach, LinkedIn 

prospecting, referrals, networking, and other independent sales activities. 

• Build, manage, and maintain an active pipeline of qualified prospects. 

• Secure introductory meetings and product demonstrations with qualified organizations. 

2. Sales Activities 

• Conduct introductory commercial discussions with prospective organizations. 

• Present the Company's products, services, and value proposition. 

• Understand prospective client requirements and determine business suitability. 

• Arrange product demonstrations and commercial meetings with the COO. 

• Maintain professional follow-up throughout the qualification process. 

3. Opportunity Management 

• Qualify opportunities in accordance with the Company's commercial criteria. 

• Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activity updates. 

• Progress qualified opportunities through the sales pipeline. 

• Refer qualified opportunities to the COO for commercial discussions, negotiations, and 

contract execution. 

• Prepare pipeline updates and activity reports as required. 

4. Sales Support 

• Professionally represent Ro&® during approved networking events, conferences, 

webinars, and business development activities. 

• Contribute market intelligence, customer insights, and competitor information that 

supports business growth. 

• Maintain current knowledge of the Company's products, services, target industries, and 

competitive landscape. 

5. Performance Expectations 

• Consistently generate qualified business opportunities.

description:
Remote Sales Representative | Appointment Setter & Closer 



About Nelaur Space



Nelaur Space is a growing AI automation and web solutions agency helping service-based businesses improve their operations, attract customers, and increase sales. We provide AI automation, CRM systems, websites, and other digital solutions designed to help businesses grow efficiently.



We are looking for a confident and results-driven Sales Representative who can turn leads into qualified appointments and qualified appointments into paying clients.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you are:



* Confident, persuasive, and professional on phone and Zoom calls

* Fluent in spoken and written English and preferable French too

* Comfortable contacting prospects and handling rejection

* Reliable, punctual, and consistent with daily responsibilities

* Highly organized and attentive to details

* Skilled at listening, asking the right questions, and identifying client needs

* Able to handle objections without becoming pushy or unprofessional

* Self-motivated and capable of working independently

* Driven by targets and excited about earning commissions

* Honest and accurate when reporting activities and results

* Interested in growing with a young company over the long term



Key Responsibilities



Lead Generation and Appointment Setting



* Respond quickly and professionally to inbound leads.

* Contact outbound prospects through phone,
, SMS, and social media.

* Qualify prospects based on their needs, budget, decision-making authority, and timeline.

* Book qualified business owners onto the sales calendar.

* Follow up consistently with leads who do not respond immediately.

* Flag lead-quality concerns when necessary.



Sales Consultations and Closing



* Conduct discovery and sales calls through Zoom or phone.

* Understand each prospect’s challenges, goals, and current systems.

* Present Nelaur Space’s services clearly and connect them to the prospect’s needs.

* Explain the value of our AI automation, websites, and CRM solutions.

* Handle questions and objections professionally.

* Negotiate pricing or scope only within approved limits.

* Close qualified prospects and secure signed agreements or deposits.

* Continue following up with warm prospects who do not purchase during the first call.



CRM and Pipeline Management



* Record every lead interaction in GoHighLevel.

* Move opportunities accurately through pipeline stages: New, Contacted, Booked, Follow-Up, Closed Won, or Closed Lost.

* Keep contact information, call notes, outcomes, and follow-up dates current.

* Record clear reasons for won, lost, or delayed opportunities.

* Maintain an organized pipeline with no forgotten leads.



Client Handoff and Reporting



* Transfer complete closed-client information to the onboarding or delivery team.

* Submit daily reports covering outreach, conversations, appointments, follow-ups, and closed deals.

* Communicate any client expectations agreed upon during the sales process.

* Participate in regular sales reviews and coaching sessions.



Tools and Technology



You should be comfortable learning and using:



* GoHighLevel CRM

* Zoom and Google Meet

* Google Workspace

*
, SMS, and social media messaging

* Online calendars and appointment-booking tools

* Internal communication and reporting platforms



Previous GoHighLevel experience is an advantage but not required if you have strong CRM experience and can learn quickly.



Required Qualifications



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Previous experience in appointment setting, telesales, business development, or closing

* Confidence making outbound calls every working day

* Strong discovery, objection-handling, negotiation, and follow-up skills

* Experience working with a CRM system

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection

* Quiet and professional home office suitable for sales calls

* Dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions



Experience selling websites, SaaS, digital marketing, CRM systems, automation, or other business services is highly preferred.



How Success Will Be Measured



Your performance will be evaluated using clear and reasonable targets, including:



* Outbound contacts completed

* Qualified appointments booked

* Appointment show rate

* Sales calls conducted

* Close rate

* Monthly revenue generated

* Follow-ups completed on time

* CRM accuracy and pipeline organization

* Quality of client handoffs

* Consistency and professionalism



Final activity and revenue targets will be discussed during onboarding.



Compensation and Benefits



* Base salary of 3CAD per Hour plus 3 percent commission on successfully closed sales 

* Reliable and timely payment

* Sales training, scripts, CRM access, and ongoing coaching

* Opportunity to work with international business owners

* Clear performance expectations and commission tracking

* Long-term opportunity with a growing company

* Potential advancement to Senior Sales Representative or Sales Manager



How to Apply—Read Carefully



Applications that do not follow all the instructions below will not be considered.



Use this subject line:



"BLUE – Sales Closer – [Your Full Name]"



In your application, include:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role.

2. A link to your résumé.

3. A 60–90 second voice or video recording introducing yourself and describing your sales experience.

4. The products or services you have previously sold.

5. Your average monthly appointment-setting or closing results, including numbers where possible.

6. An example of a difficult sales objection you handled and how you responded.

7. The CRM platforms you have used.

8. Your internet speed and backup arrangements.

9. Your earliest available starting date.



At the end of your application, answer this question in two or three sentences:



"A prospect says, “Your service sounds useful, but I need to think about it.” What would you say next?"



We are looking for someone who wants to build a successful sales career—not someone searching for a temporary role. If you are dependable, coachable, confident on calls, and hungry to achieve meaningful results, we would be glad to hear from you.

Process engineering and geodetic survey data for ongoing international projects.

Work with digital orthophoto plans created from survey data, including creation, validation, and updating.

Manage and maintain GIS databases, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and accessibility of geospatial information.

Collaborate with architects, engineers, and BIM specialists to integrate GIS data into project workflows.

Support the production of spatial analysis and mapping outputs for project teams.

Ensure all work meets project standards, quality requirements, and delivery timelines.

Continuously develop technical skills in GIS tools and related technologies.



Requirements

Education & Experience

Higher education in GIS, Geodesy, or a closely related field (Geodesy preferred).

Practical experience working with GIS products, particularly ArcGIS.

Understanding of the technologies and stages involved in creating digital orthophoto plans.

Familiarity with geodetic survey data processing workflows.



Skills & Competencies

Strong proficiency in ArcGIS and/or other GIS platforms.

Ability to work with spatial databases and manage geospatial datasets.

Attention to detail and diligence in completing assigned tasks accurately.

Strong teamwork and communication abilities, enabling collaboration in a multidisciplinary environment.

Self-motivated with a genuine drive for professional growth and learning.

Ability to manage workload and meet deadlines independently.



Nice-to-have

Experience with BIM environments or integrating GIS data into BIM workflows.

Familiarity with other GIS platforms (e.g., QGIS, other ESRI products).

Experience working in an international or remote team environment.



What REMBOX Offers

Official employment through a B2B contract.

Opportunity to work on large-scale, meaningful international projects in Israel and the USA.

Professional growth and self-fulfillment opportunities within a growing global company.

Exposure to new technologies, including work within the BIM environment.

A collaborative, people-centered work culture with like-minded professionals.

A clear pathway for growth alongside the company as the Philippines office expands.

The chance to be part of the founding team of REMBOX Philippines, shaping the team from the ground up.



Employment Structure

This role is offered as an official B2B contract engagement. The work setup transitions in two phases:



| Phase | Details | | :----------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Remote - First 3 months | Fully remote work arrangement while the REMBOX Philippines office is being established. | | Office-based - Month 4+ | Transition to an office-based format once the REMBOX Philippines office is operational. |

title: DPA Outreach and Lead Management Specialist
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a persistent, personable DPA Outreach and Lead Management Specialist to contact owners, heirs, relatives, and other parties connected to distressed or complicated properties.



This role requires strong rapport-building, thoughtful questioning, and the ability to uncover ownership, probate, title, tax, lien, and family-related issues. The ideal candidate is confident, curious, emotionally intelligent, organized, and comfortable handling sensitive conversations while identifying decision-makers and gathering accurate information for the acquisitions team.



Work Schedule

• Part-time position

• Approximately 30 hours per week

• Six hours per day, five days per week

• Monday through Friday

• Must be available during agreed-upon Central Time working hours

• Consistent attendance and punctuality are required



Primary Responsibilities

• Make outbound calls to individuals connected to distressed properties and estates

• Contact owners, heirs, relatives, former owners, neighbors, and other potential stakeholders

• Use a friendly, professional, and curiosity-based calling approach

• Determine how each contact is connected to the property, owner, or estate

• Ask thoughtful follow-up questions to understand the complete property and family situation

• Identify potential heirs, decision-makers, ownership interests, and influential family members

• Perform limited manual skip tracing to locate additional contacts

• Document detailed and accurate notes in the company CRM

• Maintain follow-up dates and complete assigned follow-up activities

• Follow company scripts, processes, compliance standards, and training materials

• Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and ongoing training



Required Qualifications

• At least one year of outbound cold-calling, lead-generation, collections, customer-service, appointment-setting, or phone-sales experience

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Clear, professional, and confident phone presence

• Ability to build rapport quickly

• Strong listening and follow-up-question skills

• Strong attention to detail

• Excellent note-taking and organizational skills

• Experience using a CRM or lead-management platform

• Dependable, coachable, self-motivated, and results-oriented

• Comfortable receiving feedback and participating in call reviews



Preferred Experience - Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:

• Real estate wholesaling

• Distressed-property acquisitions

• Manual skip tracing

• Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or a similar CRM

• Prior Upwork experience with positive client reviews



Real estate experience is preferred but may not be required for an exceptional candidate with strong outbound calling, investigative, or relationship-building experience.



Ideal Candidate Profile - The ideal candidate is:

• Curious and comfortable asking follow-up questions

• Persistent without being aggressive

• Personable and emotionally intelligent

• Patient with complicated situations

• Comfortable speaking with multiple people connected to the same property

• Able to recognize important context clues

• Resourceful when information is incomplete

• Organized and disciplined with follow-up

• Comfortable being measured by both productivity and quality

• Interested in learning distressed real estate, probate, ownership, and title-related concepts



Technology and Workspace Requirements - Applicants must have:

• A reliable computer or laptop

• A professional noise-canceling headset

• A quiet and distraction-free workspace

• Stable high-speed internet

• Ability to use online research tools, spreadsheets, calling systems,
, and CRM software

• Ability to participate in video meetings and training sessions



Calling and Performance Expectations - This is a performance-based role. However, DPA conversations can vary significantly in length and complexity. Performance will be evaluated using both activity and quality standards.



Performance measurements may include:

• Outbound call attempts

• Number of contacts reached

• Attendance and schedule adherence

• Call quality and professionalism

• Responsiveness to coaching and training



The goal is not simply to make the highest number of calls. The goal is to identify the right people, gather the right information, and move qualified opportunities forward.

Expected activity levels will be adjusted based on list quality, contact rates, call duration, research needs, and the complexity of each assigned file.



Compensation

• $5 per hour

• Approximately 30 hours per week

• $250 commission for each qualifying transaction that successfully closes

• Additional performance bonuses may be offered for qualified opportunities, successful acquisitions handoffs, appointments, or consistent achievement of performance standards



Commission eligibility, lead attribution, qualifying-deal requirements, payment timing, and performance-bonus rules will be provided in writing before employment begins.



This is a direct-hire opportunity and not an entry-level training position.



Application Instructions

1. Send your application to 
 using the following subject line:

DPA OUTREACH SPECIALIST

Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.

Please include:

2. Your current résumé

3. A one-minute video introducing yourself and describing your proudest professional accomplishment

4. Disc Test - Send us an updated one using this link below: discpersonalitytesting.com/free-disc-test/

5. Your available working hours in Central Time

6. A list of the CRM and calling systems you have used

7. A link to your Upwork profile, when applicable



Important: This position requires patience, persistence, good judgment, and professionalism. You may speak with individuals dealing with death, inheritance, family disagreements, financial hardship, or complicated property situations.

We are not looking for an aggressive telemarketer. We are looking for someone who can listen carefully, build trust, gather meaningful information, and help our team understand the complete story surrounding a property.

title: FINANCIAL ANALYST (eCOMMERCE)
description:
FINANCIAL ANALYST (eCOMMERCE) | THE eCOMMERCE CFO



Role Type: Independent Contractor

Location: 100% Remote (AEST overlap required)

Retainer: $2,500 USD per month (Fixed, Full-Time, Exclusive)

Reports To: Judith Hobdell, Founder | The eCommerce CFO





ABOUT THE eCOMMERCE CFO



The eCommerce CFO is a specialist financial consultancy working with 7- to 8-figure eCommerce brands across Australia, the UK, the USA, and Canada. Some clients are single brands. Some are multi-entity. Every one of them sells something different.



Our job is to make eCommerce finance simple. We translate complex financial data into a clear story that founders actually understand, so that when they come to us with a financial decision, we have the data to say yes or no quickly and confidently.



Most CFOs talk about scaling. We build brands to sell, whether the founder exits or not. That distinction shapes everything we do, from how we set up the books to how we read the numbers.



I am Judith Hobdell. I have 20 years in finance, 13 in eCommerce, and I co-founded four eCommerce brands before starting The eCommerce CFO in 2023. I also built and scaled a digital marketing agency, which means I understand how the numbers connect to growth strategy. I have my own IP on how founders should manage money, and I am constantly learning and sharing that with my team.



We are not a traditional accounting firm. We are a small, high-trust team that moves with purpose.





OUR CULTURE AND VALUES



Precision over speed.

The numbers have to be right. A wrong figure in a client report is never acceptable. We take accuracy seriously because our clients make real decisions based on what we produce.



Simplicity over complexity.

We strip things back to what matters. No bloated dashboards, no overcomplicated models. Clean systems, clear data, straight-up reporting. Simple scales. Complexity kills clarity.



Curiosity over compliance.

We want people who ask "why does this look off?" not people who tick boxes and move on. Strong communication means saying what needs to be said, clearly and directly, whether that is to a bookkeeper, to me, or about a number that does not add up.



Ownership without micromanagement.

You are hired to deliver an outcome. I will not be standing over your shoulder. What I do expect is that you take full accountability for your role, your deadlines, and your output. If something goes wrong, own it. Mistakes are human and they are welcome here, because they are how we build better processes, tighten our SOPs, and improve. What is not welcome is hiding them.



Evolve or fall behind.

The eCommerce landscape changes constantly. We stay ahead of it. That means embracing AI as a tool that makes us faster and sharper. If you are not already using AI in your workflow, this environment will push you to start.



How we work day to day:

The team runs a daily check-in on Slack, sharing what they are working on and flagging anything blocking them. At the end of each week, everyone does a brief sign-off on Slack. Once a week we meet on Zoom for an HQ call to connect as a team. Everything else runs through Slack and Loom.





THE ROLE



I am looking for a Financial Analyst who can function as a "mini-me." This role sits at the intersection of a Financial Controller and an FP&A Analyst.



You will own the monthly reporting pack across multiple client accounts. You will set up and maintain live reports in Syft, run cash flow forecasts, and perform budget versus actuals analysis. You will review the data produced by the bookkeeping team, question anything that looks off, and ensure everything is accurate before it reaches me.



Every eCommerce brand is different. You will be working across varied business models, product categories, and markets simultaneously. The work is never monotonous.



I handle all client-facing calls and performance videos. Your job is to make sure the numbers behind them are flawless.



This is an exclusive arrangement. You will be working solely for The eCommerce CFO. No other clients, contracts, or income sources alongside this role.



Hiring process: Shortlisted candidates will receive pre-screening questions. Successful candidates will begin with a paid trial period before moving to a permanent retainer arrangement.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Monthly Management Reports: Full P&L review and management reporting pack, accurate and complete.

- Monthly Performance Reports: Performance summaries aligned to the KPIs that matter to each brand.

- Monthly Cash Flow Forecasts: Rolling forecasts with Budget vs. Actuals variance analysis.

- Monthly KPI Reviews: Tracking and reporting on key financial and operational metrics per client.

- Live Syft Reports: Setting up and maintaining automated, live financial reports in Syft.

- Data Quality Control: Reviewing bookkeeper output, identifying errors, and coordinating amendments before reports are finalised.





WHAT WE USE



Xero - Primary accounting platform (most clients)

QuickBooks - Accounting platform (select clients)

Syft - Live financial reporting and dashboards

Google Sheets - Forecasting, budgeting, and ad hoc analysis

Slack - Daily communication, check-ins, and sign-offs

Loom - Async video communication

Notion - Internal documentation and SOPs

Zoom - Weekly HQ team call





WHO YOU ARE



Non-Negotiable:



- Minimum 5 years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, or financial controlling.

- Proficiency in both QuickBooks and Xero. You must know both.

- Demonstrated forecasting experience. You have built rolling forecasts and cash flow models from scratch, not just maintained them.

- Advanced Google Sheets skills.

- Comfortable managing multiple client accounts simultaneously without losing accuracy or missing deadlines.

- Available to overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST).

- Actively uses AI tools as part of your working process.

- Available exclusively for this role. No other clients or income sources.



Strongly Preferred:



- eCommerce experience (Shopify, DTC brands, marketplace sellers).

- Experience in a fractional CFO, outsourced finance, or multi-client environment.

- Familiarity with Syft, Fathom, or Spotlight Reporting.



The Right Person:



You take genuine pride in your work. You are inquisitive, not passive. You thrive with autonomy and take ownership of your outcomes. You want to grow as a finance professional by being close to CFO-level decision-making, not to build your own agency on the side. You communicate clearly, raise issues early, and treat deadlines as non-negotiable.





WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- This is not a bookkeeping role.

- This is not a client-facing role.

- This is not the right role if you want to maintain other clients or build your own business alongside it.





HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please submit all of the following:



1. Use the subject line: "Pineapple" (applications without this will not be opened).

2. Your updated resume or CV.

3. A short personal note, not a generic cover letter, explaining why you want to work with me, Judith Hobdell, and what genuinely excites you about this environment. I will know if it is copy-pasted.

4. Your Myers-Briggs (MBTI) personality type (4 letters only, for example INTJ). No screenshots needed.

5. At least one sample report or dashboard you have built. Redact any confidential client information.



Shortlisted candidates will receive pre-screening questions based on their sample report. A paid trial period precedes any permanent arrangement.





The eCommerce CFO | Remote | AEST | Built to sell. Whether you exit or not.

title: Meta Media Buyer
description:
NOTE: Please do not apply if you primarily have lead gen experience.



About Lucyd



Lucyd is a performance marketing and growth agency helping ambitious wellness brands scale through acquisition, retention, creative strategy, and conversion optimization.



We specialize in building scalable growth systems for brands operating in policy-constrained wellness, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (including GLP-1s and research peptides), supplements, and functional wellness products.



We are more than an agency executing individual services. We operate as integrated growth partners embedded in our clients’ businesses, helping them solve challenges across the entire customer journey—from customer acquisition and retention to creative, websites, and conversion optimization.



Our team moves quickly, communicates transparently, and operates with a high level of ownership and accountability. We care deeply about outcomes, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and long-term client partnerships.



---



Why This Role Exists



The Media Buyer, Paid Social is responsible for bringing growth strategies to life through exceptional execution on Meta.



Working closely with a Growth Strategist, you’ll build, launch, optimize, and scale paid social campaigns that drive profitable growth for our clients. You’ll combine strong platform expertise with analytical thinking to make informed optimization decisions, uncover opportunities through data, and continuously improve campaign performance.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys executing at a high level, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in operational excellence.



---



Working in Complex Advertising Environments



Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward.



Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products.



Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly.



---



What You’ll Own



Campaign Execution & Optimization



- Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across a portfolio of DTC ecommerce clients.

- Execute testing plans across audiences, creatives, placements, budgets, and campaign structures.

- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimization decisions that improve efficiency and profitability.

- Manage campaign budgets and pacing while maintaining alignment with client performance goals.

- Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform-related challenges.



Performance Analysis



- Analyze campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager and supporting analytics platforms.

- Identify trends across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and funnel performance.

- Understand *why* creative is succeeding or underperforming, using performance data to generate actionable insights.

- Monitor key performance metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and other leading indicators.

- Prepare performance updates and reporting for internal stakeholders and client-facing meetings.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



- Partner closely with Growth Strategists to execute paid media strategies across assigned accounts.

- Collaborate with Creative teams by providing data-backed recommendations for new concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative testing opportunities.

- Contribute ideas during creative strategy discussions while helping ensure creative testing aligns with account priorities.

- Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding campaign performance, blockers, and opportunities.

- Participate in client calls as needed and communicate confidently in written client updates.



---



What Success Looks Like



Successful Media Buyers consistently:



- Execute campaigns accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail.

- Achieve client MER, aMER, CAC and bCAC goals through disciplined optimization and testing.

- Move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality.

- Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams.

- Complete work reliably, follow established processes, and demonstrate strong operational excellence.

- Use data to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve performance over time.



---



What You Bring to the Table



Required



- 3+ years of experience managing Meta advertising for DTC ecommerce brands.

- Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

- Experience managing six-figure monthly Meta advertising budgets.

- Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, audience strategy, and optimization best practices.

- Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce ecommerce brands.

- Ability to analyze creative performance and identify the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong written communication skills and comfort participating in client meetings when needed.

- Experience working successfully in a remote environment.

- Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.



Preferred



- Experience working with third-party attribution platforms such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar.

- Experience advertising within policy-constrained wellness industries, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (GLP-1s, peptides), supplements, and functional wellness.

- Experience managing campaigns on TikTok, X, or Snapchat.

- Familiarity with GA4 and ecommerce analytics.

- Experience collaborating closely with creative teams on performance marketing initiatives.



---



Who Thrives at Lucyd



Successful Paid Social Media Buyers at Lucyd are proactive, detail-oriented operators who enjoy turning strategy into execution.



They are analytical, adaptable, and naturally curious about what drives performance. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. They thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy solving complex problems with data, and embrace continuous learning as advertising platforms evolve.

title: Technical Automation Specialist — GHL, Vercel & Claude Code
description:
Company: Conek — a fast-scaling marketing agency for US chiropractors



 Location: Remote



 Type: Full-time



Who we are

Conek runs patient-acquisition systems for chiropractic clinics across the US — ads, lead gen, a full call centre, and the automation that ties it all together. We're scaling fast and on a mission to become the #1 agency for chiropractors in America. This role owns the technical engine behind all of it.



The role



You build and run the systems that let us fulfil for clients and scale without breaking. Three tools, three clear jobs: GHL is our backend — it's how we deliver for every client. Vercel is where we build the landing pages and funnels that convert. Claude Code is how we build everything internal — dashboards, automations, and AI agents that make the whole agency run leaner. You own all three.



Non-negotiables (do not apply without these)



Go High Level (GHL) — deep, hands-on expertise. This is our entire fulfilment backend, so you've built and debugged sub-accounts, workflows, pipelines, triggers, calendars, and integrations at scale. Not "I've logged in."

Vercel — you've built and deployed real landing pages and funnels in production, and you care that they look sharp.

Claude Code — you've genuinely shipped with it and you're fluent working agentically in the terminal, using it to build tools and automations, not just autocomplete.

If you don't have all three, this isn't the role for you — and that's fine.



What you'll own



GHL (our fulfilment backend): build and maintain every client's sub-accounts, automations, pipelines, and integrations — forms, dialers, deposit/payment collection, reporting. When fulfilment depends on it, you own it.

Vercel (funnels & landing pages): design, build, and ship high-converting, great-looking landing pages and funnels for our offers and clients.

Claude Code (internal systems & AI agents): build internal dashboards, automate our processes wherever possible, and stand up AI agents that make us more efficient — e.g. a customer-success agent that lives in Slack and responds to people, internal ops bots, reporting automations.

Reliability: hunt down bottlenecks before they cost us bookings, and fix them without being asked.



Who you are



Extreme ownership. Full accountability for the wins and the losses. No excuses, no finger-pointing — you own the outcome.

Relentlessly proactive. You spot the problem and solve it before anyone raises it. You move first.

A real problem-solver. Ambiguity is where you do your best work.

High-intensity operator. We move fast and go deep. You're energised by a demanding pace and a team that ships, not one that clocks out at a bottleneck.

Sharp communicator. Clear, direct, no fluff — what broke, what you did, what's next.



Why Conek



You won't maintain someone else's stack. You'll architect the technical engine of an agency scaling toward #1 in its category — GHL, Vercel, and Claude Code all yours to build on, with the autonomy to do it right and the visibility for it to matter.



How to apply

Send a LOOM video going over all 3: (NO LOOM = NO APPLICATION CONSIDERATION)



One GHL build you're proud of — what it did, how complex, what you'd improve.

One thing you've shipped with Claude Code — ideally an internal tool, automation, or agent — plus the Vercel deployment behind it if there is one.

One system you fixed or built that nobody asked you to — and what happened.
