description:
About Us

Miracle Homes is a Singapore-based real estate brand specialising in landed and high-value residential properties. Alongside our property content, we run the Miracle Family brand — a faith-centred family lifestyle channel. Our content spans YouTube education, social media, and podcast productions across multiple channels.



We are a small, tight team that moves fast. We care about quality, and we care about the people we work with.



About the Role



You will be supporting our Head of Content to keep our video production pipeline running smoothly. This is a hybrid production and pre-production role — you ensure our editor has everything they need, our archives stay organised, and our content calendar keeps moving. Video editing capability is an added advantage.



This is an hourly engagement. Work volume will vary week to week depending on active productions.



What You'll Be Doing



Pre-Production & AI-Assisted Content Planning

1.Review existing video scripts and episode formats to understand brand voice, structure, and tone

2. Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to draft first-pass scripts following established templates (hook, body, CTA structure)

3. Break down scripts into production briefs: shot lists, b-roll requirements, on-screen text, and caption notes

4. Flag gaps in scripts where property jargon needs clarification before shoot day

5. Maintain the content calendar — episode titles, status, publish dates, and platform

6. Research trending topics, keywords, and YouTube search angles relevant to Singapore real estate and family lifestyle

7. Prepare episode outlines for review by Head of Content before full scripting begins

8. Repurpose long-form YouTube scripts into short-form captions, Reels hooks, and podcast descriptions

9. Build and maintain a script library organised by series, topic, and format



Archive & File Management

1. Organise and maintain NAS and Google Drive folders by project, date, and content type

2. Label, tag, and log raw footage with descriptive file names

3. Maintain a master asset library



B-Roll Research & Sourcing

1. Source relevant stock footage based on video scripts and topics

2. Build a b-roll bank by category (landed property, family lifestyle, Singapore landmarks)

3. Flag usable b-roll timecodes within raw footage



Subtitle & Caption QC

1. Review and correct auto-generated subtitles for accuracy

2. Ensure correct use of Singapore real estate jargon, property terms, and local references

3. Sync captions and prepare SRT files for upload



Post-Production Coordination

1. Track edit versions, consolidate feedback, and manage revision rounds

2. Upload and schedule finalised videos with YouTube metadata (titles, descriptions, tags)

3. Maintain our property jargon glossary



Bonus: Video Editing (Optional but Preferred)

1. Trim and assemble footage from provided scripts and shot lists

2. Add captions, basic motion graphics, and music

3. Deliver platform-ready cuts for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and podcast video



You're a Great Fit If You:

1. Have experience in video production, content coordination, or post-production support

2. Have used AI tools in a real content or production workflow — not just experimentally

3. Are highly organised and can manage files and workflows without being micromanaged

4. Communicate clearly and flag problems early

5. Can learn industry-specific vocabulary quickly (we will provide a glossary)

Are proficient in DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar (editing a bonus)

6. Have worked with real estate, property, finance, or education content (preferred)



Tools We Use

Google Drive, NAS storage, YouTube Studio, CapCut / Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve, WhatsApp, Claude / ChatGPT



What We Offer

2. Clear briefs and structured workflows — we do not drop chaos on you

title: Experienced Credit Repair Dispute Strategist Needed
description:
Experienced Credit Repair Dispute Strategist Needed



We are looking for an experienced Credit Repair Specialist / Dispute Strategist who is highly skilled in analyzing credit reports, creating effective dispute strategies, and achieving results for clients.



This is not a basic letter-writing position. We are looking for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and understands how to approach difficult credit profiles using multiple dispute strategies while staying compliant with applicable credit laws.



The ideal candidate has experience handling complex credit files and knows how to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, reporting errors, and areas where creditors or bureaus may not be reporting information correctly.



Key Responsibilities:



•?  ?Manage client credit repair files from start to finish using Credit Repair Cloud.

•?  ?Analyze all three credit reports (Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion) to identify dispute opportunities.

•?  ?Develop customized dispute strategies based on each client’s unique credit profile.

•?  ?Create and manage dispute campaigns, follow-ups, escalations, and responses.

•?  ?Track bureau responses and adjust strategies when needed.

•?  ?Communicate case updates, findings, and recommended next steps.

•?  ?Maintain detailed records of disputes, responses, deletions, and progress.



Must Have Experience With:



•?  ?Credit Repair Cloud (required)

•?  ?FCRA and FDCPA knowledge

•?  ?Credit report analysis

•?  ?Fact-based dispute strategies

•?  ?Bureau investigation processes

•?  ?Metro 2 reporting standards

•?  ?Identifying inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable information



Experience Disputing Items Such As:



•?  ?Collections

•?  ?Charge-offs

•?  ?Late payments

•?  ?Hard inquiries

•?  ?Repossessions

•?  ?Bankruptcies

•?  ?Foreclosures

•?  ?Judgments

•?  ?Public records

•?  ?Student loans

•?  ?Child support reporting

•?  ?Mixed files and inaccurate personal information



We Are Looking For Someone Who:



•?  ?Thinks creatively and does not use a one-size-fits-all approach.

•?  ?Can look at a difficult file and identify multiple dispute angles.

•?  ?Understands that every client profile requires a different strategy.

•?  ?Has a proven history of helping clients achieve credit improvements.

•?  ?Can explain the reasoning behind their dispute strategies.

•?  ?Is constantly learning and staying updated on credit reporting practices.



Interview Requirements:



Please be prepared to answer:



?1.? ?How do you approach a client file that has multiple negative accounts reporting across all three bureaus?

?2.? ?What is your process for analyzing a credit report before creating disputes?

?3.? ?What are some common reporting errors you look for when reviewing negative accounts?

?4.? ?How do you handle accounts that come back verified after the first dispute?

?5.? ?What different dispute strategies have you used besides standard validation disputes?

?6.? ?How do you determine whether an account has a strong dispute opportunity?

?7.? ?Can you provide examples of difficult accounts you have successfully helped remove or correct?

?8.? ?How do you track dispute progress and communicate updates?

?9.? ?How familiar are you with Metro 2 reporting and identifying inconsistencies?

10.? ?What separates an average credit repair specialist from an excellent one?



Qualifications:



•?  ?2+ years of hands-on credit repair experience.

•?  ?Proven experience managing client dispute files.

•?  ?Strong knowledge of credit laws and reporting standards.

•?  ?Excellent attention to detail.

•?  ?Strong communication and organization skills.



Benefits:



•?  ?Flexible schedule.

•?  ?Long-term opportunity with consistent client volume.

•?  ?Opportunity to work with a growing credit services company.

title: Laser Cutting Programmer
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Laser Cutting Programmer (Virtual Assistant) to support sheet metal fabrication operations remotely. In this role, you will be responsible for converting 2D/3D CAD designs into optimized, machine-ready nesting layouts and program files using CypNest and CypCut software for CNC fiber laser cutting machinery.



You will work closely with our remote project managers and onshore workshop operators to maximize sheet material yield, streamline cutting runtimes, and deliver high-precision cut files.



Key Responsibilities



- CAD/CAM & Nesting: Import and review 2D/3D CAD drawings (.DXF, .DWG, .STEP) using CypNest to generate optimized sheet layouts and toolpaths.



- CypCut Parameter Management: Assign accurate laser parameters in CypCut, including lead-ins/lead-outs, micro-joints/tabs, pierce conditions, cooling points, and common-line cutting sequences.



- Material Yield Optimization: Execute manual and automated nesting strategies in CypNest to minimize scrap, lower machine cycle times, and effectively manage remnant plate inventory.



- Drawing & Quality Check: Inspect client drawings for manufacturability before production—flagging geometry errors, tight hole-to-thickness ratios, and tolerance issues.



- Remote Production Support: Coordinate with workshop operators to troubleshoot cut settings, handle part revisions, and resolve nesting path errors remotely.



- Data & Quoting Assistance: Export nesting reports, cut time estimates, and material utilization summaries from CypNest to assist with job costing and project tracking.



Requirements & Qualifications



- Software Expertise: Proven experience programming fiber lasers using CypNest and CypCut (FSCUT / Friendess ecosystem).



- CAD Skills: Proficiency in drafting and editing 2D/3D metal parts in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or equivalent CAD tools.



- Fabrication Knowledge: Strong understanding of sheet metal properties (mild steel, stainless steel, aluminum), kerf widths, heat distortion prevention, and laser cutting dynamics.



- Communication & Precision: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with strong attention to detail.



Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications



- AU Client Experience: Prior experience working with Australian (AU) sheet metal fabrication clients, engineering standards, or working within Australian time zones (e.g., AEST / AEDT / AWST).



-Familiarity with tube laser cutting software (e.g., TubeT / TubePro) or press brake nesting.



What We Offer



- 100% remote work setup.



- Competitive compensation.



- Consistent schedule with room for long-term growth.

title: Accountant - UK
description:
AMN Collective Solutions is a UK chartered accountancy practice, serving owner-managed limited companies, sole traders, landlords and contractors across Hertfordshire and North-West London. We work in a fully cloud-based environment and are Xero-certified and Making Tax Digital (MTD) compliant.



Our client base spans a range of sectors including motor trade, construction, bridging finance, property and IT consultancy. 

We are growing steadily and are expanding our offshore delivery team to support that growth.





This Accountant role will take ownership of the preparation of UK statutory year-end accounts and UK personal tax returns from client records through to a file ready for director review and submission. The role also carries responsibility for supporting bookkeeping, VAT and management reporting work as the portfolio requires.



This is a delivery-focused, technically demanding role. The successful candidate will be expected to produce a complete, well-referenced working paper file with minimal supervision, and to raise clear, specific queries rather than leaving gaps.



Key responsibilities:



 UK statutory accounts preparation:



• Prepare year-end statutory financial statements for UK limited companies from client bookkeeping records, trial balances or accounting excel records.

• Prepare accounts under FRS 102 Section 1A (small entities).

• Produce accounts within TaxCalc Accounts Production, ensuring correct entity type, accounting framework, disclosure set and comparative figures.

• Complete full year-end control account reconciliations, including bank, VAT, PAYE/NIC, director's loan account, trade debtors and creditors, accruals, prepayments and stock.

• Prepare and post year-end journals covering depreciation, accruals and prepayments, deferred and accrued income, dividends, corporation tax provision and opening balance corrections.

• Maintain a fixed asset register and calculate depreciation in accordance with the client's stated accounting policies.

• Identify and reconcile director's loan account movements, flagging any overdrawn positions and the associated s.455 CTA 2010 and benefit-in-kind implications.

• Build and maintain a complete, cross-referenced working paper file supporting every material balance, ready for director review.

• Prepare a schedule of open queries for the client, with a clear explanation of what is required and why.

• Ensure accounts are prepared and filed within Companies House and HMRC statutory deadlines, and maintain the internal deadline tracker.



UK Self Assessment tax returns:



• Prepare individual Self Assessment tax returns (SA100) using TaxCalc, including the following supplementary pages as applicable:

– SA102 — employment income, benefits in kind and expenses;

– SA103S / SA103F — self-employment;

– SA105 — UK property, including furnished holiday lettings and the finance cost restriction under s.272A ITTOIA 2005;

– SA106 — foreign income;

– SA108 — capital gains, including residential property disposals;

– SA109 — residence and remittance basis, where relevant.

• Prepare rental accounts and property income schedules from client-supplied records.

• Prepare sole trader and partnership accounts and the resulting self-employment pages, including capital allowances computations and the correct treatment of disallowable expenditure.

• Calculate dividend and savings income, the personal allowance taper, payments on account and balancing payments, and prepare a clear tax liability summary for the client.

• Reconcile employment income to P60s, P45s and P11Ds, and pension contributions to relief-at-source or net pay arrangements.

• Prepare partnership returns (SA800) and the associated partner allocations where required.

• Track the 31 January and 31 July deadlines and escalate at-risk cases in good time.



 Corporation tax:



• Prepare corporation tax computations and CT600 returns in TaxCalc, with iXBRL-tagged accounts and computations.

• Prepare capital allowances computations, including annual investment allowance, full expensing, first-year allowances, writing down allowances and the balancing adjustments on disposal.

• Identify and correctly treat disallowable expenditure, including entertaining, depreciation, non-trade items and provisions.

• Apply the correct rate of corporation tax, including marginal relief and the effect of associated companies.

• Prepare loss relief claims and note the relevant statutory basis for each.



Bookkeeping, VAT and payroll support:



• Maintain client bookkeeping in Xero, including bank reconciliations, purchase and sales ledger maintenance and receipt capture

• Prepare and reconcile quarterly VAT returns under MTD, including standard, flat rate, cash accounting and, where applicable, margin scheme and domestic reverse charge treatments.

• Support CIS processing, including subcontractor verification, monthly returns and deduction statements.

• Provide support with payroll processing and auto-enrolment pension uploads where required.



Management reporting:



• Produce periodic management accounts, including profit and loss, balance sheet, variance analysis and short commentary.

• Prepare cash flow summaries, aged debtor and creditor reports and bespoke client reporting packs.



 Practice administration and quality:

• Maintain accurate records of time and job status on the practice workflow system.

• Keep client files, working papers and correspondence filed in accordance with practice procedures.

• Draft clear, professional client
s in British English for director review.

• Keep up to date with UK GAAP, tax legislation and HMRC guidance relevant to the portfolio.

• Adhere at all times to the practice's confidentiality, data protection and anti-money laundering procedures.



If you read the full job description and wish to separate yourself from other applicants and show us your attention to details then start your application message with the phrase "Blue Butterflies :) " 



Systems used:



Accounts and tax production: TaxCalc (Accounts Production, Tax Production, Company Secretarial).



Bookkeeping: Xero (primary), FreeAgent, Clearbooks



Document capture: Google Drive



Productivity and communication: Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams), SharePoint or OneDrive for document storage.



Statutory portals: HMRC Agent Services Account and Companies House WebFiling, accessed strictly under the practice's own credentials and controls.



Full training will be given on our internal processes, file structure and house style. Prior TaxCalc experience is strongly preferred but candidates with equivalent UK software experience will be considered.

title: AI Architect, Trainee Level, Long Term With A Path Up
description:
Meta Know Labs is an AI automation company based in the United States. We build systems that run the repetitive parts of a business in the background. We are hiring one person and training them from zero into an AI Architect.



Read carefully, because this role is unusual. You do not need technical experience. You will not be asked to already know automation, coding or any platform. The technical expertise comes from an AI system that guides every step, and from the people who will train you. What we need from you is the ability to read carefully, write down exactly what you see, and follow an instruction precisely.



Picture an expert engineer sitting beside you, telling you what to click. Your job is to be accurate eyes and steady hands, and to write down everything you are thinking while you do it. That writing is the real skill of this job and it is what we will train hardest.



We pay you while you learn. That is the point of this company. We take people who have never done this work and we build them into people who can, and we pay them from the first hour rather than asking them to arrive already trained.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Follow step by step guidance and execute it exactly.

Report what is truly on the screen, using the screen's own words.

Write your questions, your observations and your confusion constantly as you work.

Keep clear, honest records of what happened.



WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED

Experience with any automation tool.

A coding background.

A degree.

The ability to design technical solutions on your own.



WHAT YOU DO NEED

Fast typing. You will write a great deal every single day.

Excellent written English.

The willingness to write down that you do not understand something, with no embarrassment about it. Nobody here is judged for that and it is the core of the method.

Discipline to follow an instruction exactly rather than take your own shortcut.

Honesty. If something breaks or looks wrong, you say so immediately.

A stable computer and reliable internet.



HOW YOU WILL WORK

You will connect to our computer using AnyDesk, which is free remote desktop software. Everything you need is already installed and ready on that machine. We work this way so you are never blocked by software you do not have, and so the person training you can see exactly what you see.



HOURS

First week, training. Monday to Friday, 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Manila time, four hours a day. This is when the whole team is online together, which is why training happens then.

From week two onward. Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Manila time. Eight hours a day, ordinary daytime hours in your country.



PAY

$3.00 per hour for the first month while you train.

$3.50 per hour from the second month.

It continues to rise as you take on more responsibility. Paid through Wise.



THE PATH

This is not a short contract. Trainee is the first rung of a ladder that runs Trainee, Junior, Certified, Senior and Lead, and each level carries a higher rate. You are hired at the bottom of it on purpose. How fast you move up is d
 by your work, not by time served, and the people above you on that ladder were trained the same way you will be.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your message with the word Reality. That tells us you read the whole post.



Then complete the short task below. It is the main thing we use to d
, so take your time and do it properly. Your resume matters far less to us than this does.



THE TASK



The core skill in this job is writing your thoughts directly into a piece of text, in square brackets, at the exact spot where the thought happens. We will show you how it works, then ask you to do it once.



Suppose we sent you this instruction:



Click the red "Save" button at the bottom of the page.



And on your actual screen the button is green, it says "Save Changes", and it sits in the middle of the page rather than the bottom. You would send it back to us looking like this:



Click the red [mine is green] "Save" [it actually says Save Changes] button at the bottom [it is in the middle of the page, not the bottom] of the page.



Three thoughts, each one sitting exactly where it occurred. That is the entire method.



NOW YOUR TURN



Below are four instructions. Whoever wrote them could not see your screen, so parts of them will not match what you find. That is expected, and finding those parts is the point of the exercise. You are not being tested on getting it right. You are being tested on how clearly you can show us what is really there.



Open your web browser. Actually attempt each step. Then copy all four lines into your application and send them back with your thoughts written inside them in square brackets. This is called the Annotation Method. Your first lesson.



1. Click the settings gear in the top left or right corner of your browser.

2. A menu will drop down with four options.

3. Click the third option, which is called Preferences.

4. At the top of the page that opens there is a section header. Write down what it says.



Write every thought you have, including small ones. Anything you do not understand, anything that does not match, anything you are unsure of, anything you had to guess at. There is no wrong answer and nothing is too minor to include. We are looking at how much of what you actually experienced makes it onto the page, so more writing is better than less.



Do not tidy it up and do not simplify it. Send us the messy, complete version.



LAST QUESTION



In a few sentences, tell us about something you learned by doing rather than by being taught.

 needed. Please include everything below so we can review your application properly.

title: Video Editor & Ad Creative Producer
description:
# Video Editor & Ad Creative Producer



We are hiring a **Video Editor and Ad Creative Producer** to join our company’s creative team and create short-form video advertisements.



This is a behind-the-scenes editing role. **You will not need to appear in any videos, film yourself, speak on camera, or post content from your own social media accounts.**



We have a process for finding and obtaining the videos, and we will show you how it works. Your job will be to find strong video footage, download it, create an engaging caption or hook, and turn it into a completed advertisement using CapCut.



## What You Will Do



* Scroll through TikTok to find high-quality videos that can be used as background footage.

* Identify videos that are visually engaging and suitable for advertisements.

* Download the selected videos to your phone.

* Edit the videos using CapCut.

* Create attention-grabbing captions and hooks for each video.

* Add the captions and hooks directly onto the video.

* Make sure the text is clear, readable, properly placed, and free of spelling errors.

* Follow the examples and process we provide.

* Develop new caption ideas and creative angles independently.

* Produce approximately **30 completed advertisements per day**.

* Organize and submit completed videos consistently and on time.



## Important Clarification



This is **not an influencer, content creator, or on-camera position**.



You will not be required to:



* Show your face.

* Record yourself.

* Speak in the videos.

* Film original content.

* Build your own TikTok account.

* Post the advertisements yourself.



This is a video-editing and advertisement-creation role for our company.



## Requirements



You must be able to:



* Use TikTok confidently.

* Recognize high-quality and engaging video content.

* Download videos to your phone.

* Use CapCut to edit short-form videos.

* Write creative captions and hooks.

* Add and format text on videos.

* Work quickly without sacrificing quality.

* Follow instructions and examples accurately.

* Work independently without needing constant supervision.

* Consistently produce approximately **30 advertisements per day**.

* Own an iPhone or another newer smartphone.



You do not need experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or other advanced editing software. **CapCut is the only editing program you need to know how to use.**



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Extremely self-sufficient.

* Creative with captions and hooks.

* Comfortable making decisions independently.

* Fast, efficient, and hardworking.

* Reliable and consistent.

* Detail-oriented.

* Able to understand the assignment without needing every individual video explained.

* Willing to learn and follow our creative process.



The right person should be able to scroll through TikTok, recognize a good video, download it, think of a strong caption or hook, add it in CapCut, and submit a completed advertisement.



## Preferred Experience



The following experience is a plus, but it is not required:



* Creating TikTok, Instagram, or
 advertisements.

* Editing short-form social media videos.

* Performance marketing or direct-response advertising.

* Affiliate marketing.

* CPI or app-install offers.

* Freecash.

* Playful.

* Testerup.

* Gravy Pass.

* Working with an affiliate marketing company, media buyer, advertiser, or creative team.



## How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. A brief explanation of your CapCut and short-form video-editing experience.

2. Examples of videos or advertisements you have previously edited.

3. How long you have been using CapCut.

4. Whether you have previously created advertisements for TikTok, Instagram,
, or another platform.

5. Whether you have experience with affiliate marketing, CPI offers, Freecash, Playful, Testerup, Gravy Pass, or similar offers.

6. If you have previously worked with an affiliate marketing company, agency, media buyer, advertiser, or creative team, include the name of the company or person.

7. The type of phone you currently use.

8. Confirmation that you can consistently produce approximately 30 completed advertisements per day.

9. A brief explanation of how you would find a good TikTok video and turn it into an engaging advertisement.



Begin your application with the words **“CAPCUT EDITOR”** so we know you carefully read and understand the full job description.



We are only considering applicants who understand that this is a high-volume, self-sufficient video-editing and advertisement-creation role.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Location: Remote Type: Part-time



About the Role



Pronexis is looking for a UI/UX Designer with strong knowledge of Call Center, CRM and lead management platforms to help shape the experience of our franchise technology platform. You'll design flows and interfaces for the tools our franchisees and their teams use every day — agent experience, lead capture, pipeline management, campaign builders, and agent-facing workflows — working closely with Product Owners, engineers, and the Solutions team.



This role is less about visual polish alone and more about deeply understanding how CRM and lead-management workflows actually work, so the interfaces you design hold up under real, messy, day-to-day use.



What You'll Do

Design end-to-end UI/UX for CRM-adjacent features: lead capture forms, pipeline/kanban views, contact and account management, campaign and segment builders

Design call center / agent lobby interfaces — screenpop layouts, active call screens, softphone controls, and queue/routing views — for agents handling live calls and chats

Translate complex business logic (segments, triggers, conditions, workflow automation) into interfaces that are clear to non-technical franchise staff

Design for real operational contexts — agents fielding live calls, franchisees managing high lead volume — not just idealized happy paths

Partner with Product Owners and engineers early in discovery to shape feasible, well-scoped designs rather than receiving requirements after the fact

Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups, and iterate based on feedback from stakeholders and (where available) usage data

Contribute to and help maintain a consistent design system across the platform

Review implemented features against design intent and flag drift before release



Must-Haves

Strong portfolio demonstrating CRM or lead-management platform design (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, ServiceMinder, Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, or similar)

Experience designing call center / contact center interfaces — agent desktops, screenpops, active-call states, queue and routing views — for high-volume, real-time environments

Solid grasp of common CRM/lead-gen UX patterns: pipelines, lead scoring, segmentation, campaign workflows, contact/account hierarchies

Experience designing for complex, rule-based systems (conditional logic, triggers/actions, automation builders) in a way that stays usable for non-technical end users

Comfortable working directly from business requirements and asking the right clarifying questions rather than working in a vacuum

Proficiency with standard design tools (Figma or equivalent) and ability to hand off clean, dev-ready specs



Nice-to-Haves

Experience designing for the franchise or field-service industry specifically

Familiarity with voice/telephony platforms (Twilio or similar) and how call state/data should surface in the UI

Experience working alongside Laravel/React engineering teams and understanding technical constraints when designing

Background in usability testing or running lightweight design validation with real users



What Success Looks Like



Within your first few months, you're independently owning design for CRM-adjacent features, catching usability issues in complex workflows before they reach engineering, and becoming the person the team trusts to translate "how lead management should work" into interfaces that actually hold up in practice.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller — UK B2B (SaaS)
description:
QuorumInsight is a UK software company that tells suppliers what local councils are planning to buy before it's publicly announced. We analyse recordings of 300+ UK council meetings and extract early procurement signals, giving our clients 6–18 months of advance warning over their competitors.





## The role



You'll call warm, pre-qualified lists of UK companies and book demos into the founder's calendar. This is not a generic script-reading job. Every call is anchored to a real, specific piece of intelligence about that prospect's local council — for example: "Cardiff Council discussed retendering their schools cleaning contract three weeks ago — has that reached you yet?" We give you the intelligence; you start the conversation.



Most prospects have never heard of what we do, so your first job on every call is to explain, in one or two sentences, that councils discuss their buying plans in public meetings months before any tender appears — and that we capture it. 



## What you'll do



- Make outbound calls to UK small and mid-sized businesses (facilities management, construction, consulting) during UK business hours

- Open each call with the council-specific signal we provide for that prospect

- Qualify quickly: do they bid for council contracts, do they have a bid manager or business development person, do they already pay for a competing service (Stotles, Tussell, Tracker, BiP — this is our strongest buying signal)

- Book qualified demos into the founder's calendar and confirm attendance with reminder calls/messages

- Log every call and outcome in our CRM (Odoo — we'll train you)

- Call prospects who opened or replied to our
 campaigns but haven't booked yet

- Share weekly feedback: which objections you hear, what wording works, which industries respond best



## Targets



For a 20-hour week, after a two-week ramp:



- 40–60 dials per day worked

- 3–5 qualified appointments booked per week

- 70%+ show rate (you own the confirmations)



A qualified appointment = right type of company, right person, demo actually attended. Bonuses are paid on quality, not calendar volume.



## Requirements



- 2+ years of cold calling or appointment setting for UK, US, or Australian B2B campaigns — you can share your numbers

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent — you'll be speaking with British business owners and managers

- Confident explaining something the prospect has never heard of; you enjoy the "wait, that's possible?" reaction

- Available to work UK business hours (approximately 4:00 PM – 12:00 midnight Philippine time; we'll agree a fixed window within that, e.g. 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT to catch the UK morning and lunchtime)

- Reliable setup: quiet home workspace, noise-cancelling headset, stable internet (at least 25 Mbps, with backup), and a computer that can run a browser-based dialler and CRM

- Disciplined with CRM logging and follow-ups; comfortable being measured on outcomes, not hours online



**Bonus points for:** experience selling software subscriptions, data or market intelligence products; any exposure to government or procurement-related campaigns; familiarity with Odoo, Instantly, or VoIP diallers.



## Compensation



Base monthly pay (part-time) + per-qualified-appointment bonus + a percentage of first-year revenue on any deal that closes from your bookings. Paid twice monthly via Wise or your preferred method. Exact figures depend on experience and will be discussed at interview — the structure is designed so a good month clearly beats a flat rate. Consistent performance leads to full-time hours and increased base pay.



## How to apply





1. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and pitching us any product you like (this matters more than your CV)

2. Your cold calling numbers from a previous campaign (dials/day, appointments/week, show rate)

3. One or two lines on your experience calling UK or US markets





Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

**About Sculpted Peaks**



Sculpted Peaks creates hand-carved stone sculptures of iconic mountains, made by artisans in Bali and shipped worldwide. As we expand our mountain lineup, we need a detail-obsessed visual researcher and designer who can help us find, source, and prepare the reference imagery that drives every new sculpture from concept to launch.



---



**Role Overview**



The Research & Design Assistant supports the visual pipeline for new sculptures. You will research mountains and identify ideal viewpoints using online tools, source and license reference photography from stock platforms, and use Photoshop, Lightroom, and AI image generation tools to prepare design mock-ups and product variant images for the website.



You will work directly with our in-house graphic designer and our Ecommerce Merchandising Coordinator, integrating into existing workflows for new product development and page preparation.



---



**Key Responsibilities**



Mountain Research & Image Sourcing



- Research specific mountains and identify photographically strong viewpoints using Google Earth, Google Maps, and public reference sources

- Search stock photography platforms (Adobe Stock, Getty, Shutterstock, etc.) for licensable images from target viewpoints

- Evaluate image quality, angle, and licensing terms and flag best candidates for team review

- Track sourcing status and licensing details in Notion



Design & Mock-up Production



- Edit and prepare reference images using Photoshop and Lightroom

- Build and update product design mock-ups for new sculptures and product variants

- Use AI image generation tools (including Weevy) to produce multivariate product images showcasing alternate finishes, colors, and presentations

- Maintain organized asset libraries in Dropbox with consistent naming conventions



Workflow Integration



- Follow existing SOPs for new product visual pipeline

- Coordinate with the in-house designer on design quality and asset handoff

- Collaborate with the Ecommerce Merchandising Coordinator to ensure assets are ready for product page builds

- Keep Notion updated on research status, image sourcing, and asset readiness



---



**Qualifications**



- Strong working knowledge of Photoshop and Lightroom (required)

- Experience with AI image generation tools is a strong plus

- Skilled at web research, cross-referencing multiple sources, and identifying the best photographic viewpoints of geographic subjects

- Comfortable navigating stock photography platforms and understanding licensing structures

- High attention to detail and strong visual judgment

- Experience with Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, and Dropbox

- Ability to work independently and manage your own task queue

- A genuine interest in mountains, geography, or landscape photography is a bonus

$800 to $1,200 per month depending on experience

title: Accounting Executive
description:
About Scriveiner

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.



The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.



Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.





The Opportunity

Scriveiner is at a pivotal point in its growth expanding into new premium product categories, scaling its Amazon and Shopify channels, and building the operational infrastructure to support a significant step-change over the next three years. As the business grows, so does the need for a finance function that is not just accurate, but sharp.



We are hiring an Accounting Executive to sit at the operational core of the Finance team. This is a role for someone who understands UK accounting deeply, works confidently without a manual, and brings the kind of proactive judgment that means problems get spotted before they become problems. The Finance Manager is looking for someone who improves how the function works not just someone who keeps pace with it.



Day to day, you will own the transactional engine of the business: AP, AR, bank reconciliations, VAT, month-end close, and the accuracy behind every financial report we produce. But the expectation goes further than execution. You will look at how we do things, identify where they can be tighter, and take genuine ownership of the financial integrity of a lean, fast-moving business. The systems you help build now will underpin Scriveiner at twice its current size.



What You Will Own

Own the accuracy and completeness of daily financial transactions, AP, AR, invoicing, and payment runs ensuring every entry is correctly authorised, coded, and filed

Lead bank and supplier reconciliations, resolving discrepancies proactively rather than waiting for month-end to surface them

Take full ownership of VAT preparation and filing support, maintaining compliance with UK regulations

Drive month-end and year-end close activities, moving the process forward with minimal direction

Maintain clean audit trails across all financial records digital and physical so documentation is always ready, not assembled at the last minute

Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current financial processes and bring forward practical improvements you are expected to flag what is not working and suggest what should replace it

Support the preparation of management accounts, P&L summaries, cash flow reports, and balance sheet reconciliations that the Finance Manager and founders can rely on

Liaise with internal teams and external suppliers on financial queries, acting as a reliable point of contact who resolves issues without escalation

Contribute to forecasting and budgeting inputs as the business plans for growth across new product categories and marketplaces

Perform intercompany reconciliations, ensuring transactions between business entities are accurately recorded and resolved in a timely manner

Assist in the preparation of divisional profit and loss accounts, supporting clear visibility of performance across the business

Ensure correct expense allocation across business divisions, maintaining accuracy and consistency in how costs are assigned and reported





Who You Are

Essential — you must have this:

Solid, hands-on UK accounting experience you understand VAT, AP/AR workflows, reconciliations, and month-end close as second nature

Proven proficiency with at least one major accounting platform: Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage

Strong Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and basic data modelling without needing to be shown

A track record of working independently, you manage your own workload, flag risks early, and do not require close supervision to maintain accuracy

A genuine drive to improve how a finance function works, not just maintain it  you notice inefficiencies and act on them

High attention to detail with a professional approach to confidentiality and financial data

Experience working within a business with a turnover of £10 million or more





Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have this:

Familiarity with e-commerce accounting, particularly Amazon Seller Central or Shopify financial flows

Experience working in a small or scaling business where finance is a lean, high-ownership function

Exposure to multi-currency transactions or international marketplace accounting





What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will be successful when:

Financial records are consistently accurate, up to date, and audit-ready without prompting

Bank and supplier reconciliations are completed on time with discrepancies identified and resolved proactively

VAT filings and compliance obligations are met without error or delay

Month-end close is completed efficiently, with reports the Finance Manager and founders can rely on

You bring forward at least one meaningful improvement to financial processes or systems within your first 90 days

The Finance Manager spends less time checking and more time using the information you produce



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out the form here: 



Please note that candidates with UK accounting experience will be given preference during the selection process.

title: US Payroll & Accounting Operations Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a family-run refrigerated trucking company based in Florida. We operate approximately 19 trucks, six nights per week, hauling seafood and produce along the East Coast.



We are rebuilding our accounting and operations processes using better systems, clear written procedures, and practical automation. We are looking for someone who is accurate, organized, dependable, and interested in growing with the company.



The Role



Your initial responsibility will be taking ownership of our payroll and accounting-operations processes.



This includes:



* Payroll preparation and review

* Driver per diem and cash-advance reconciliation

* Trip-document review

* Vendor-bill entry

* Check preparation

* Accounts-payable support

* Document organization

* QuickBooks entry

* Process documentation and improvement



This is not basic data entry. You will be expected to understand what the documents mean, identify missing information, investigate differences, and maintain clear support for every number entered.



Over time, a strong performer may take on additional billing, accounts-receivable, reconciliation, and financial-reporting responsibilities.



What You Will Own:



1. Payroll



* Learn and document our complete payroll process.

* Prepare and review payroll information for drivers and employees.

* Compare payroll information against dispatch records, trips, and supporting documents.

* Identify missing or inconsistent information before payroll is finalized.

* Maintain payroll records and supporting documentation.

* Track payroll corrections, reimbursements, advances, and exceptions.

* Complete payroll work accurately and according to a fixed schedule.



Direct experience with US payroll is strongly preferred.



2. Driver Trip Bags



Our drivers return physical trip envelopes called **trip bags**. Each trip bag should include receipts, trip logs, fuel information, mileage information, trip numbers, truck numbers, and other supporting documents.



You will:



* Review scanned trip bags for completeness.

* Confirm that required trip logs and receipts are included.

* Match receipts and expenses to the correct driver and trip.

* Identify missing, duplicate, or unsupported expenses.

* Maintain a list of missing documentation.

* Follow up with the Florida team until all required information is received.

* Organize completed trip records in a consistent digital filing system.



Our Florida office will collect and scan the physical paperwork. You will own the review, reconciliation, tracking, and accounting process.



3. Per Diem and Driver Cash Advances



Drivers may receive cash advances through Comdata for:



* Per diem

* Gate fees

* Unloading fees

* Other approved trip expenses



You will:



* Review weekly Comdata reports.

* Match cash advances to the correct trip and driver.

* Compare per diem to the approved payroll table.

* Separate each advance into the proper expense category.

* Properly allocate advances covering two drivers.

* Confirm that non-per-diem expenses have supporting receipts.

* Identify and report unexplained or unsupported amounts.

* Provide a completed breakdown for accounting and trip-cost reporting.



4. QuickBooks and Accounts Payable



* Enter vendor bills into QuickBooks.

* Confirm the vendor, date, amount, expense account, department, and supporting documentation.

* Check for duplicate bills.

* Attach supporting documents when available.

* Maintain accurate vendor records.

* Prepare checks and payment packages for review.

* Track payment status and properly file support after payment.

* Never release or move company funds without US approval.



5. Document and Administrative Support



* Maintain organized payroll, trip, vendor, and accounting files.

* Review scanned hand tickets and bills of lading.

* Confirm that all required documents are included before sending them to billing.

* Send completed digital packets to the appropriate tea
mber.

* Assist with invoices that must be mailed or faxed.

* Provide dispatch sheets and supporting records when requested.

* Retrieve documents quickly when management, customers, or auditors request them.



6. Process Improvement



* Write a clear SOP for every recurring task.

* Create checklists and exception trackers.

* Recommend ways to reduce repetitive manual work.

* Use Excel, Google Sheets, and approved AI tools to improve efficiency.

* Maintain human review over payroll, accounting entries, and payment decisions.

* Never use AI to guess or create accounting numbers.



- Required Qualifications



* At least three years of bookkeeping, payroll, or accounting experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

* Strong QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop experience

* Direct payroll-processing or payroll-review experience

* Accounts-payable and vendor-bill experience

* Strong reconciliation and problem-solving ability

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to maintain confidential payroll and employee information

* Ability to work independently and communicate problems clearly

* Reliable computer, internet connection, backup internet, and backup power



- Software Requirements:

Must already be strong in:

* QuickBooks Online

* Excel or Google Sheets

* US payroll processing software

* Google Workspace

Preferred Softwares:

* Paychex Flex

* Comdata or another fuel-card platform

* Motive or another fleet-management system

* Experience working with driver settlements, advances, reimbursements, or per diem





- Preferred Credentials



* Philippine CPA or other accounting credential

* Experience working for a US-based company

* Trucking, freight, logistics, construction, or job-costing experience

* Experience with driver settlements, per diem, cash advances, or expense reports

* Experience with Comdata, Motive, fuel cards, or fleet expenses

* Experience creating written SOPs and process videos

* Experience improving or automating bookkeeping workflows



Work Schedule



* Full-time remote position

* Monday through Friday

* Must have regular overlap with the Florida accounting team

* Exact schedule can be discussed with qualified candidates

* Must be available for video calls and screen-sharing during training



Compensation



* $1,300–$2,000 USD per month depending on experience

* Higher compensation may be available for candidates with strong US payroll, trucking, or CPA experience

* Paid twice monthly through Wise

* 13th-month bonus

* Paid Philippine holidays

* Paid time off after the introductory period

* Performance and compensation review after 90 days

* Company-paid AI and work-related software tools



What Success Looks Like After 60 Days



You should be able to:



* Complete payroll-related work accurately and on schedule.

* Review trip bags and identify missing documentation.

* Reconcile driver per diem and cash advances.

* Correctly enter vendor bills in QuickBooks.

* Prepare complete payment and check packages.

* Maintain a clear exception list.

* Retrieve supporting documents quickly.

* Follow written procedures with limited supervision.

* Improve and document the processes you own.



How to Apply



Start your message with the word **REEFER**.



Answer the following questions in order:



1. What payroll processes have you personally handled?

2. Have you processed payroll for a US-based company? Which payroll system did you use?

3. Which QuickBooks functions have you personally performed?

4. Describe a time you had to reconcile employee advances, per diem, reimbursements, or expense reports.

5. Describe a situation where supporting documents were missing. How did you resolve it?

6. Tell us about one accounting process you documented, improved, or automated.

7. Are you a CPA or licensed accountant?

8. What hours can you work in Manila time?

9. What is your internet and backup-power setup?

10. What monthly compensation are you seeking in USD?



Please also include a two- to three-minute Loom or Google Drive video answering this question:



> Walk us through how you would review an employee expense report or trip packet containing a cash advance, several receipts, and one missing document.



Do not show confidential information from a current or former employer.

title: Dispatcher/Freight Broker/Logistic
description:
SendaRig Dispatch Group L.L.C.

Logistics Coordinator

Independent Contractor - Full-time|  Remote / Jersey City, NJ

Experience Level: Senior — Dispatch AND Brokerage Experience Required

SendaRig Dispatch Group L.L.C. is a New Jersey-based freight services company built on a simple premise: carriers deserve a partner who works for them, not around them. We manage load sourcing, rate negotiation, dispatch operations, and freight brokerage under our own FMCSA operating authority, with the professionalism and operational discipline carriers and shippers can count on.

The Opportunity

We're hiring one Logistics Coordinator to own the entire freight lifecycle, dispatch and brokerage combined, under one title, one desk, one paycheck built on your own performance.

This is not a narrow, single-lane role. You will operate across the full chain: Carrier ? Dispatcher ? Broker ? Shipper, moving fluidly between both sides of the freight relationship as the day demands.

We are only looking for candidates who are already highly experienced in both Freight Dispatch and Brokerage. If that's you, we think you'll like how this role is built, you won't be stuck relearning fundamentals or proving yourself on one side of the business while sitting out the other. You'll be trusted to run with the whole Operations from day one.

What You'll Own

?      End-to-end dispatch operations: load sourcing, rate negotiation, carrier management, and invoicing

?      Full-cycle brokerage: quoting, booking, and managing freight for shippers under SendaRig's FMCSA broker authority

?      Carrier vetting and onboarding, including authority verification, insurance compliance, and safety review

?      High-stakes rate negotiation on both sides of a transaction, carrier and shipper, protecting company margin without damaging relationships

?      Long-term relationship-building with carriers and shippers alike

?      Daily execution inside DAT One Loadboards (Carrier and Broker), AscendTMS, Google Workspace, and Nextiva

What You Bring

?      Demonstrated, verifiable experience on both the freight dispatching and freight brokerage, not one paired with a passing familiarity with the other. We screen specifically for this distinction, so candidates should be prepared to speak to real, specific transactions on both sides of the business.A demonstrated track record of successful negotiation with carriers and shippers

?      Fluency, not familiarity, with DAT One Loadboards, AscendTMS, and Google Workspace

?      A solid command of FMCSA fundamentals: operating authority, insurance requirements, hours-of-service, and broker regulations under 49 CFR Part 371

?      The composure to run multiple live negotiations at once without losing precision on any of them

How You're Paid

This role earns on two revenue streams at once, dispatch fees and brokerage margin, and because you're doing the work of two specialists, you're paid at meaningfully better rates than either single-specialty position at SendaRig:

Dispatch commission is tiered, the better you negotiate a carrier's dispatch fee into their service agreement, the higher your share on every load from that carrier:

Negotiated Dispatch Fee Charged To Carrier Your Share

Tier 1 8% of carrier gross load value 45%

Tier 2 7% of carrier gross load value 40%

Tier 3 6% of carrier gross load value 35%

Your negotiated tier holds for six months per carrier, then you can push to move them up at the review point. Every successful renegotiation raises your earnings on that carrier going forward.

Brokerage commission is tiered based on your monthly closed and collected load volume, the more you close, the higher your rate that month:

Brokered Loads Closed & Collected / Month Your Share of Gross Profit

Fewer than 8 15%

8 – 14 20 or more 25%

 

Example:

 Put the numbers to work across an actual month. At 25 dispatch loads, roughly what an experienced coordinator managing several carrier relationships can realistically carry, your Tier 1 commission of $77.76 per load adds up to $1,944.

Add 18 brokered loads that month,  achievable number when  you're running with real systems behind you, and at our top 25% tier, each one pays $78.75. That's another $1,417.50.

Combined: $3,361.50 for the month, on standard market-rate freight, calculated the same way every load is calculated: transparently, load by load, with nothing hidden in the math.

This isn't a ceiling. It's what one month looks like for someone who already knows how to work both sides of this business. Push harder, negotiate stronger dispatch fee tiers, or close more brokered freight, and the number moves with you.

 

Where This Goes

A demonstrated six-month track record opens direct paths to advancement: a base salary plus commission structure, a renegotiated commission rate that reflects your performance, or oversight of Operations as SendaRig's brokerage division expands.

You would be joining at a stage where these structures are still being defined, giving you direct influence over how this role, and this division is built forward.

 

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

You won't be one of a dozen dispatchers in a call center queue. You'll be the person who owns freight from the first carrier call to the final shipper invoice, working directly with leadership, with your judgment and your numbers speaking for themselves. If you're genuinely good at both sides of this business and have been waiting for a seat that actually reflects that, this is it.

To Apply

Send the following to 

?      Your resume

?      A summary of your dispatch AND brokerage experience, specifically

?      The platforms you've worked with (DAT, Truckstop, AscendTMS, etc.)

call us directly at (888)
(Toll-free), or visit our website 

 

Qualified applicants will be invited to a video interview to walk through real-world negotiation scenarios and problem-solving on both sides of the freight relationship.

SendaRig Dispatch Group L.L.C.  —  Guiding Every Load Forward

title: Reddit Creative Strategist & Copywriter
description:
About the Role:

Karmic is a marketing agency that builds and runs organic and paid content programs on Reddit for a portfolio of consumer brand clients. As a Reddit Creative Strategist, you’ll own the day-to-day creative engine behind our clients’ owned subreddits, spotting what’s resonating on the platform right now and shipping polished, native-feeling content that doesn’t read like it came from an AI.

This is a hands-on creative and editorial role, not a hands-off one. You’ll lead content strategy, writing, editing, and posting daily across multiple clients’ communities.



What You’ll Do:

- Lead content strategy and writing for each client’s subreddit, drawing on relevant viral Reddit posts, real-time news, and client content to create original, engaging thread ideas grounded in what’s trending right now.

- Use AI tools to draft first-pass Reddit posts efficiently, treating AI output as a starting point rather than a finished product.

- Execute significant copy editing on AI-drafted content to eliminate any evidence of AI writing, rebuild genuine emotional resonance, and craft hooks that open curiosity loops to maximize engagement, since a post’s performance lives or dies on its first line.

- Execute posting and ongoing maintenance of client threads, building and growing each community over time.

- Stay closely attuned to the culture and norms of each subreddit you work in, adjusting tone and format so content reads as native rather than promotional.

- Monitor content performance and feed learnings back into the broader strategy.



What We’re Looking For:

- 3+ years of experience in content marketing, growth marketing, or brand strategy, ideally in a writing-heavy capacity rather than an oversight-only role.

- Exceptional written English skills.

- Strong, demonstrable editing instincts: you can take a rough or AI-generated draft and make it read like a real person wrote it, catching not just obvious AI patterns but anything that just sounds unnatural.

- Genuine fluency in Reddit as a platform: how different subreddits’ cultures and norms differ, what makes a post get buried versus take off, and what reads as authentic versus promotional.

- Comfort working across multiple client accounts and brands at once, adapting voice and subject matter for each.

- Sharp copywriting instincts, particularly for hooks and headlines that create real curiosity without tipping into clickbait.

- Ability to work efficiently with AI drafting tools while holding a high editorial bar, treating AI as a tool rather than a shortcut around craft.

- Comfortable with a fast-moving, real-time content cadence tied to news cycles and trending conversations.

- Experience working with tech brands and early-stage U.S. startups.

- Ability to work independently.



Nice to Have:

- Experience writing content in a marketing agency.

- Experience running or growing a brand’s (or your own) presence on Reddit specifically, not just general social media.

- Familiarity with content performance metrics beyond vanity numbers, such as comment quality, share of voice, and sentiment.

- Background in copywriting, journalism, or content marketing.

About Rice Rice Baby

Rice Rice Baby is an exciting, high-energy Asian-inspired food brand based in Nashville, Tennessee. We operate a popular food truck, cater private events/festivals, and are opening our first Ghost Kitchen in Midtown Nashville at the end of August!

We’re not looking for someone to simply post static graphics—we’re looking for a creative short-form video editor and growth manager who wants to help build a brand that people know, trust, and crave.



Our mission: Make Rice Rice Baby one of Nashville’s most recognizable and cravable food brands, with customers lining up to order the 
nt our Ghost Kitchen opens.



How We Work Together (The Workflow)

You do not need to film on-site!

 * Our On-Site Team: Films raw, high-quality phone videos daily (cooking, sizzling food, order assembly, customer reactions) and dumps them into a shared Google Drive/Dropbox.

 * Your Role: You take those raw clips, edit them into high-converting TikToks, Reels, and Shorts, write engaging captions, schedule posts, and manage our growth strategy.



Position Overview

 * Location: Remote (Philippines)

 * Primary Platforms: TikTok, Instagram (Reels & Stories),
, YouTube Shorts. 



Our 90-Day Goals

Together, over the next 90 days, we will:

 * Build a loyal, engaged local Nashville audience.

 * Create massive viral excitement leading up to our Ghost Kitchen opening.

 * Grow our social media following organically through high-quality video.

 * Drive online delivery orders from Day 1 of our launch.

 * Increase food truck traffic and private catering bookings.

 * Establish Rice Rice Baby as one of Nashville’s go-to food brands.

Your Key Responsibilities

 * Strategy & Scheduling: Maintain a weekly content calendar focused on food truck schedules, catering, and the Ghost Kitchen launch.

 * Daily Stories: Create 4–6 interactive daily Stories (behind-the-scenes prep, truck location pins, countdown timers, polls).

 * Local Outreach: Use our pre-written templates to DM local Nashville food influencers, Vanderbilt students, hospital staff, and apartment concierges.



2-Week Paid Trial Period & Daily Expectations

To ensure we are the right long-term fit for each other, all new hires begin with a 2-week paid trial period.

During the trial, you will maintain a daily volume of 8–10 content touchpoints across platforms:

 * 2 Main Short-Form Videos: High-quality edits posted to TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

 * 2 Repurposed Cross-Posts: Adapting main clips for
 and secondary channels with customized captions and local hashtags.

 * 4–6 Interactive Stories: Real-time updates, location drops, engagement polls, and behind-the-scenes clips.

 * Daily Community Management: Replying to comments, answering menu DMs, and engaging with local Nashville accounts.



Trial Benchmarks

 * Day 5: Content calendar active, smooth footage download/upload workflow established, daily posting consistent, clear communication.

 * Day 10: Noticeable boost in video edit quality, audio selection, and snappy pacing. Trend-based content being published regularly.

 * Day 14 (Trial Completion): Flawless execution of content workflow, proven reliability, growing engagement, and a clear 30-day marketing plan submitted for our Midtown Ghost Kitchen grand opening.

Skills & Experience We Look For

 * Proven experience editing short-form videos (CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, Canva).

 * Deep understanding of TikTok, YouTube and Instagram Reel algorithms and viral food trends.

 * Experience in restaurant, food truck, hospitality, or local business social media marketing.

 * Excellent, natural English writing skills for casual and witty captions.

 * Self-starter mindset—you bring ideas to the table without waiting to be told what to do.



Bonus Skills:

 * Basic Meta Ads 
/Instagram Ads)

 * Local influencer outreach experience



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

 * Consistent, daily video publishing across all core channels.

 * Steady organic follower and engagement growth in the local Nashville area.

 * High-performing video edits that generate local buzz.

 * Increased website traffic, catering inquiries, and a high volume of Day 1 delivery orders for our Ghost Kitchen.

Who You Are

 * You think like a business owner, not just an employee.

 * You are passionate about food content and love seeing videos go viral.

Compensation & Terms

title: Podcast Editor / Story Director
description:
YOU

Do you watch a 60-minute conversation and instinctively know where the story is? Which 
nt is the hook, where it drags, what to cut and what to leave breathing? Are you a podcast editor/manager who thinks like a journalist or a director first, and reach for the editing tools second? Then read on.

This is a podcast role for someone with editorial judgment who is fluent with the software. If your instinct when handed footage is to shape the narrative rather than decorate it, we should talk.

WHO WE ARE

We're an Amsterdam based content marketing agency. Backed by 20 years of editorial experience, we provide high-quality storytelling for cutting-edge companies and entrepreneurs, across a range of subjects — whether it's about technical fabrics, personal growth and meditation, female leadership, b2b cosmetics or sustainability in fashion.

Our view on our services as well as our clients is simple: substance matters. Our strength lies in connecting people through meaningful narrative and integrating this across all relevant communication platforms.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

A podcast editor (audio and video) with the experience of a journalist or director. Someone who understands narrative and can make a long-form conversation feel natural, warm and alive, without over-producing it. You'll work on interview-style podcast episodes and solo spoken podcasts. 

Concretely, you can:

Watch a full conversation and find the thread. You proactively propose the storyline, the hook, the structure. 

Identify the strongest emotional or catchy 
nt and build an opening hook (~40 seconds) that makes people stay.

Cut and reframe to hold attention — clean speaker-based framing, single-person and two-person shots switched to match the energy of the exchange.

Keep it restrained. Preserve pauses. Let the conversation carry the piece. Know when not to cut.

Hold a consistent visual identity across episodes based on a visual identity. 

Produce polished captions and social cut-downs for Instagram Reels and LinkedIn.

Add light motion graphics where they serve the story. It doesn't need to be grand. Canva, CapCut and AI tools are all fine, as long as the result looks polished, purposeful and intentional.

Work AI-first: let AI tools carry the bulk of the load, then finesse with your own eye and sensibility so the final product feels crafted, not automated.

Support content makers with input reg. how to improve.

ABOUT YOU

You have real editorial background in journalism, documentary, film, or story-led content editing. 

You have a portfolio or showreel that demonstrates your storytelling.

You're comfortable with a modern AI-assisted workflow, and you use it to go faster without letting the work feel generic.

Your taste shows up in restraint as much as in what you add.

Your communication is on point. You can confidently pitch a treatment, take feedback constructively, and collaborate closely with our producer.

You're proactive, reliable, and able to work efficiently.

THE DETAILS

The position is freelance / part-time, hours to be discussed based on episode volume. Remote-friendly, with a preference for someone who can occasionally connect in or around Amsterdam.

INTERESTED?

Please share your online portfolio or showreel, along with a compact note. We'd especially appreciate one short example of an episode, film, or piece where you found the story, what the raw material was, and what you did to shape it. That tells us more than any tool list.

SCHEDULE  

Mon-Friday UK time (Weekends and extra shifts available)



SALARY  

US$4–$6 per hour, depending on relevant experience  

Performance and pay reviews as responsibilities grow



ABOUT US



We are a growing UK short-term rental management company. We manage Airbnb and serviced accommodation properties for landlords, with a strong focus on reliable operations, well-maintained homes, and excellent guest experiences.



We are hiring an experienced operations specialist who wants stable, long-term work and takes genuine ownership of their responsibilities.



This is not simply a guest-messaging position. You will coordinate cleaners and contractors, monitor stays, solve operational problems, and ensure every issue is followed through to completion.



WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR



You may be a good fit if you:



- Take action without waiting to be repeatedly reminded

- Investigate a problem before asking for help

- Recommend solutions instead of only reporting problems

- Follow up until a task is genuinely complete

- Notice risks early and communicate them clearly

- Remain calm and professional when guests are frustrated

- Take pride in accurate, dependable work



We do not expect you to know everything. We do expect you to think, use the available SOPs and information, and say, “Here is what I recommend and why.”



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Respond promptly and professionally to guests through Airbnb, 
, Guesty, WhatsApp/WATI, and

- Manage booking questions, amendments, extensions, arrivals, in-stay issues, and check-outs

- Monitor upcoming arrivals and identify missing information or possible problems

- Coordinate cleaners, maintenance contractors, and other suppliers

- Confirm that assigned work has actually been completed, including requesting evidence where required

- Keep guests updated while an issue is being resolved

- Own maintenance and operational issues from first report through to resolution

- Maintain accurate notes, tasks, and handovers in our systems

- Identify complaints, refund risks, and review risks early

- Escalate urgent or high-risk situations with a clear summary and recommended action

- Identify repeated problems and suggest practical improvements to our SOPs and operations



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have:



- At least two years of recent experience in Airbnb, serviced accommodation, hospitality operations, or short-term rental management

- Experience handling real guest and property issues, not only administrative tasks

- Experience coordinating cleaners, contractors, or property teams

- Excellent written and spoken English

- The ability to manage several active conversations and tasks without losing track of follow-ups

- A reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a suitable backup plan for power or internet interruptions

- Availability for the full agreed UK-time shift



SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE



Hands-on experience with Guesty is strongly preferred.



We will also consider strong applicants who have used Hostaway, Hospitable, Uplisting, Smoobu, or another short-term rental property-management system and can learn Guesty quickly.



We also use:



- Airbnb and 

- WhatsApp

- Slack

- Notion



Experience with UK short-term rentals, PriceLabs, or another revenue-management tool is an advantage.



WORK COMMITMENT AND AVAILABILITY



This is a dedicated full-time position.



You must be fully available and focused on our business during your agreed working hours. You must not perform work for another employer or client during hours for which we are paying you.



Other work outside your scheduled hours must be disclosed before hiring and must not affect your attendance, responsiveness, performance, or availability for this role.



Please do not apply if you intend to overlap this position with another full-time job.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Successful performance means:



- Guests receive fast, calm, and accurate assistance

- Open issues are actively chased until resolved

- No important task is forgotten after being reported

- Cleaner and contractor work is confirmed rather than assumed

- Records and shift handovers are complete and accurate

- Risks are escalated before they become serious complaints

- Repeated problems lead to suggested process improvements

- You are dependable and ready to work at the agreed start time



WHAT WE OFFER



- Stable, long-term remote work

- Consistent, agreed working hours

- Clear SOPs, training, and support

- Regular feedback and communication

- Opportunities to take on greater responsibility

- Pay reviews based on performance and role growth

- A paid day off for your birthday after passing probation



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words “GUEST FIRST”.



Applications missing any of the following will not be considered:



1. Describe your short-term rental experience, including the countries, number of properties, and booking platforms you supported.



2. Which property-management systems have you used? Explain what you personally did inside Guesty or the equivalent system.



3. Describe one serious guest or maintenance issue that you personally managed from beginning to end. What actions did you take, and what was the result?



4. Give an example of a problem you noticed and acted on before your manager asked you to.



5. Scenario: A guest reports at 10:00 p.m. that the heating is not working. They are upset and mention requesting a refund. The usual contractor is not answering. Explain exactly what you would do during the next 30 minutes.



6. State your current work commitments, if any, and confirm that you will not work for another company during your scheduled hours with us.



7. Confirm your internet speed, backup internet arrangement, and backup power arrangement.



8. Provide a link to a one-to-two-minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are suited to this position.



Please write your answers yourself. Generic or copied applications will not progress.



HIRING PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will complete:



- A written guest-response exercise

- A short operational scenario exercise

- A video interview

- Reference and previous-employment checks

- A paid practical trial, where appropriate



We are looking for someone reliable, thoughtful, and committed who wants to become an important long-ter
mber of our operations team.

description:

Here's the truth: we can teach you everything you need to know. Marketing, media buying, copywriting, funnel building, conversion optimization - all of it. What we can't teach is how to think. How to stay organized. How to work hard and figure things out without being told twice.

- The Position: Executive Assistant - Marketing & Operations (Trained Into Hands-On CMO)

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Don't worry if some of this is new. As you learn, you'll take on more. Here's what your weeks will eventually look like:



? Writing scripts, ads, and copy using proven Direct Response principles (this is core - you must love writing)
