? Bringing structure and processes into how we run marketing

? Overseeing video editors - reviewing their work, giving revisions, keeping quality high

? Editing funnels with drag-and-drop tools

? Media buying across Meta & Google Ads

? Product testing using our internal templates

? Helping build the team as we grow



The first weeks and months have one goal: learn as much as humanly possible.



The end goal: you become a core operator we rely on completely.



Why This Role Is Different



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for someone to invest in - and build with for the long haul.



You'll be personally trained by us - an 8-figure founding team - in the exact skills that build wealth in this industry:



? Copywriting (Scripts, Advertorials, VSLs, Native Ads)

? Media Buying (Meta & Google Ads)

? Video Editing (Understanding what makes creatives convert)

? Product Testing (Using our proven internal templates)

? Funnel Building (Drag-and-drop web design)

? CVR Optimization (A/B testing and beyond)



This is a paid education worth more than any MBA. You don't need to walk in knowing all of this - you need to be the kind of person who can learn it fast.



Who We're Actually Looking For



Read this carefully, because it matters far more than your résumé:



- You're genuinely smart. You learn fast and connect dots others miss. This is the #1 thing we care about.

- You're a strong writer. Your English is flawless, and you genuinely enjoy writing. Non-negotiable.

- You're organized. You bring order to chaos. Systems and processes come naturally to you.

- You work hard. Not "I show up" hard - "I obsess over getting it right" hard.

- You're independent. You don't wait to be told what to do. You find the work and do it.

- You're loyal. You want to grow WITH a company. We have huge plans for the next few years, and we want someone who wants to be part of that story.



We've hired brilliant people from all kinds of backgrounds. What matters most is that you're sharp, driven, and already know your way around the eCommerce or online marketing world.



If you need hand-holding, this isn't for you. If you want to plant roots and build something real, keep reading.

Comfortable with tools like Shopify, Canva, and social media (you don't need to be an expert - just comfortable and quick to learn)

Why This Changes Your Life



For the right person, this isn't a job. It's a partnership. You start at $1,500/month, but for hard workers who prove themselves, there's no ceiling. As we grow, you grow. As the brand grows into a portfolio, so does your role - and your income.



We're looking for ONE person. A long-term partner. Someone we can pour knowledge into and build the next chapter with.



How to Apply

No long essays. Just the essentials, clearly written.



We read every application personally. Show us you're the one.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (Talking Head Specialist)
description:
Overview of the Role

We are looking for a creative and technically proficient Long-Form YouTube Video Editor to join our team on a long-term, remote basis. Our channel focuses on high-level fitness coaching, specifically the $1M-Level Body program, which helps clients optimize hormones, blood work, and metabolic health. The primary responsibility involves transforming raw talking head footage into polished, high-retention educational content.



The ideal candidate understands that talking head videos require constant visual engagement. You will be expected to utilize pattern interrupts, strategic zooms, and dynamic B-roll to maintain viewer interest throughout 10–15 minute episodes.



Key Responsibilities and Expectations

The editor will be responsible for the end-to-end post-production workflow for one primary video per week, alongside managing a backlog of existing content.



Category

Specific Tasks & Responsibilities

Editing Style

Transforming raw talking head shots into dynamic sequences using zooms, crops, and multi-angle simulations.

Visual Assets

Sourcing and integrating high-quality B-roll, stock footage, and relevant iconography to support the narrative.

Motion Graphics

Creating custom animations to explain complex medical and fitness concepts, such as hormone pathways or blood work data.

Audio & Grading

Professional sound design (SFX/Leveling), background music selection, and cinematic color grading.

Backlog Management

Systematically editing existing footage to refresh our content library and maximize channel growth.



Candidate Requirements

We are seeking a specialist who is not just a "cutter," but a visual storyteller.



Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or DaVinci Resolve equivalents).



Retention Strategy: A deep understanding of YouTube analytics and how editing choices (pacing, hooks, transitions) impact audience retention.



Niche Interest: A background or strong interest in fitness, biohacking, or medical science is highly preferred to ensure accurate visual representation of technical topics.



Compensation and Application Process

We offer a competitive compensation package based on the quality of the "jazzy" edits provided.



Detail

Specification Workload

1 Main Video (10-15 mins) per week + Backlog projects.



How to Apply

To be considered for this role, please follow these instructions precisely:



1. Provide a link to your portfolio, specifically highlighting talking head videos with high-quality animations and B-roll.



2. Include a brief summary of your experience with fitness or health-related content.



3. Use the subject line: "OPTIMIZED BODY EDITOR" to confirm you have read the full description.
